jobs.title: Production Engineering Specialist (m/f/d) (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Manager Production Development

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to optimize the Production organization’s assembly methods, processes, and equipment to minimize labor hours in accordance with business strategies related to quality, efficiency, costs, and safety. Each day, you will ensure appropriate production methods, cycle time, equipment performance, and materials/components in support of production targets. You will also showcase your expertise by defining the working phase sequence of a new production process to achieve the targeted product cost and equipment investment budget.

The work model for the role is onsite.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Drive process optimization and digitalization initiatives across Battery and Converter Production by analyzing and improving production processes, shopfloor workflows, and the interaction between machines, systems, and operators.

  • Manage and further develop production data, reporting solutions, and manufacturing systems, including MES, ERP, smart tools, Power BI, and related applications.

  • Support the reliability of digital shopfloor infrastructure and provide hands-on troubleshooting for manufacturing equipment, OT systems, industrial networks, interfaces, and other production systems.

  • Support the transition from engineering to manufacturing and coordinate the implementation, testing, rollout, documentation, and training of manufacturing solutions, including product data flows, PLM processes, BOM transformations, and design guidelines.


• Qualifications for the role

  • University degree in engineering or a related technical field, or a strong technical background combined with relevant industrial experience, for example in production, assembly, testing, or maintenance.

  • Basic digital know-how and a strong interest in digital manufacturing, production systems, PLM topics, and the use of 3D models in manufacturing processes.

  • Practical understanding of industrial operations and shopfloor requirements, ideally within battery or converter manufacturing.

  • Ability to analyze production processes, workflows, manufacturing machines, and production plants, identify improvement potential, and translate findings into structured and practical solutions.

  • Interest in production data analysis and familiarity with manufacturing systems such as MES, ERP, Power BI, smart tools, OT systems, or industrial networks.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, IT, and other stakeholders. Fluency in German and English is required.

  • High motivation, curiosity, and willingness to take responsibility; basic knowledge of BOM structures, PLM processes, or troubleshooting of digital shopfloor systems is an advantage.



More about us

The ABB Traction Division is a recognized market leader in drive technologies for rail vehicles, buses, and industrial vehicles, driving innovation in electrification.

Our comprehensive portfolio of high-performance traction, auxiliary, and energy storage solutions – all managed across the entire life cycle – helps to improve energy efficiency and make transportation more sustainable.

Together, we make a difference for our customers every single day. We look forward to receiving your application.

The recruitment process is led by Talent Acquisition Partner Gema de Vicente.

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

• Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

In dieser Position haben Sie die Möglichkeit, die Montagemethoden, Prozesse und Anlagen der Produktionsorganisation zu optimieren, um den Arbeitsaufwand im Einklang mit den Unternehmensstrategien hinsichtlich Qualität, Effizienz, Kosten und Sicherheit zu minimieren. Sie stellen täglich sicher, dass geeignete Produktionsmethoden, Zykluszeiten, Anlagenleistungen sowie Materialien und Komponenten zur Erreichung der Produktionsziele eingesetzt werden. Darüber hinaus bringen Sie Ihre Expertise ein, indem Sie die Arbeitsabläufe neuer Produktionsprozesse definieren, um die angestrebten Produktkosten und das Investitionsbudget für Anlagen einzuhalten.

Der Arbeitsort für diese Position ist vor Ort.

Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören:

  • Vorantreiben von Prozessoptimierungs- und Digitalisierungsinitiativen in der Batterie- und Konverterproduktion durch Analyse und Verbesserung von Produktionsprozessen, Shopfloor-Abläufen sowie der Interaktion zwischen Maschinen, Systemen und Mitarbeitenden.

  • Verwaltung und Weiterentwicklung von Produktionsdaten, Reporting-Lösungen und Manufacturing-Systemen, einschließlich MES, ERP, Smart Tools, Power BI und verwandter Anwendungen.

  • Sicherstellung der Zuverlässigkeit der digitalen Shopfloor-Infrastruktur sowie praktische Unterstützung bei der Fehleranalyse und Störungsbehebung von Produktionsanlagen, OT-Systemen, industriellen Netzwerken, Schnittstellen und weiteren Produktionssystemen.

  • Unterstützung des Übergangs von der Entwicklung in die Fertigung sowie Koordination der Implementierung, Tests, Einführung, Dokumentation und Schulung von Fertigungslösungen, einschließlich Produktdatenflüssen, PLM-Prozessen, Stücklisten-Transformationen (BOM) und Konstruktionsrichtlinien.

Qualifikationen für diese Position

  • Hochschulabschluss im Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten technischen Fachgebiet oder ein fundierter technischer Hintergrund kombiniert mit einschlägiger Industrieerfahrung, beispielsweise in Produktion, Montage, Prüfung oder Instandhaltung.

  • Grundlegendes digitales Know-how sowie großes Interesse an digitaler Fertigung, Produktionssystemen, PLM-Themen und dem Einsatz von 3D-Modellen in Fertigungsprozessen.

  • Praktisches Verständnis industrieller Abläufe und Produktionsanforderungen, idealerweise im Bereich Batterie- oder Konverterfertigung.

  • Fähigkeit, Produktionsprozesse, Arbeitsabläufe, Fertigungsmaschinen und Produktionsanlagen zu analysieren, Verbesserungspotenziale zu identifizieren und die Erkenntnisse in strukturierte und praxisnahe Lösungen umzusetzen.

  • Interesse an der Analyse von Produktionsdaten sowie Kenntnisse von Fertigungssystemen wie MES, ERP, Power BI, Smart Tools, OT-Systemen oder industriellen Netzwerken.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion, Engineering, Instandhaltung, IT und weiteren Stakeholdern. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich.

  • Hohe Motivation, Neugier und Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Grundkenntnisse in Stücklistenstrukturen (BOM), PLM-Prozessen oder der Fehlerbehebung digitaler Shopfloor-Systeme sind von Vorteil.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

__

An opportunity has become available in ABB Swizterland as Marketing and Communications Specialist for our division Process Industries. In addition, 30% of the role will include leading assigned projects for the Global Business Line Mining & Materials.

The role holder is an enthusiastic team player, creative, proactive and self-motivated, and is familiar with digital marketing and marketing automation tools.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage several projects at the same time

  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) in English with ability to explain technology in an easy and engaging way with strong writing, editing and proofreading capabilities

  • Creative personality and innovative mindset with the capacity to come with new and fresh ideas, while ensuring consistency with brand and BL positioning

  • A solution-focused and self-starter mindset combined with passion for strategic and analytical thinking

  • Knowledge of digital marketing and marketing automation (SalesForce, Pardot, etc)

Ce poste relève de :

Global Communications Manager - BL Mining & Materials

Une opportunité est devenue disponible à ABB Swizterland en tant que spécialiste du marketing et des communications pour notre division Process Industries. De plus, 30 % du rôle consistera à diriger les projets assignés au secteur d'activité mondial de l'exploitation minière et des matériaux. Le titulaire du rôle est un acteur enthousiaste de l'équipe, créatif, proactif et automotivé, et il est familier avec les outils numériques de marketing et d'automatisation du marketing.

En faisant rapport au gestionnaire des communications et du marketing du secteur d'activité mondial pour l'exploitation minière et les matériaux, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de gestion et de vente locales et le secteur d'activité Communications Dirige l'élaboration, la localisation et la mise en oeuvre d'initiatives et de campagnes intégrées de communication du marketing pour promouvoir le portefeuille et les références des principaux intervenants, y compris les clients, les médias commerciaux, les influenceurs et les employés.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : hybride

Votre rôle et responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez la possibilité de proposer et de mettre en œuvre des plans de communication. Chaque jour, vous mettrez en oeuvre les activités de communication marketing assignées à travers tous les outils de communication disponibles selon les lignes directrices, directives et messages de groupe, dans le budget approuvé. Vous mettrez également en valeur votre expertise en générant des pistes par le biais de la publicité, du parrainage et d'autres activités promotionnelles, en utilisant Internet comme centre de communications marketing intégrées.

Vous serez principalement responsable :

  • En tant que partenaire stratégique en matière de communications auprès de la direction locale Soutenir la commercialisation et les communications mondiales (30 % du rôle)pour une gamme de produits désignée au sein du portefeuille des mines et matériaux, par le leadership de la pensée, les initiatives de soutien de premier plan, les lancements de produits, l'habilitation des ventes et la présence sur les médias sociaux


• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Université Diplôme de préférence en journalisme, communication, marketing ou domaine connexe

  • Minimum 5 années d'expérience en communication marketing, idéalement dans les agences de communication ou les industries connexes du B2B

  • Fort compétences en gestion de projet avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs projets en même temps

  • Excellentes compétences en communication (verbale et écrite) en anglais avec la capacité d'expliquer la technologie de façon facile et engageante grâce à de solides capacités d'écriture, d'édition et de correction

  • Personnalité créative et état d'esprit novateur avec la capacité de venir avec des idées nouvelles et nouvelles, tout en assurant la cohérence avec la marque et le positionnement BL

  • Un état d'esprit axé sur la solution et auto-démarrant combiné avec la passion pour la pensée stratégique et analytique

  • Connaissance de la commercialisation numérique et de l'automatisation du marketing (SalesForce, Pardot, etc.)


En savoir plus sur nous

Process Industries division offre des solutions complètes d'électrification et d'automatisation, des produits spécifiques à l'industrie et des services de cycle de vie dans toutes les industries. L'ingénierie et la fourniture de solutions d'automatisation de l'appareil à la surveillance et au contrôle font que nos clients tirent davantage parti de leur investissement; les solutions de numérisation incluant des opérations collaboratives et la réalité augmentée contribuent à améliorer la productivité des usines et des entreprises, à réduire les coûts d'entretien et d'énergie. Notre portefeuille d'ingénierie, de gestion de projet, de services et de solutions couvre un large éventail d'industries - mines, pâtes et papiers, métaux, aluminium et ciment, centres de données et aliments et boissons.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Program Manager Solid State Transformer

__

Your role and responsibilities
We are looking for a Power Systems Architect to join our Direct Current Data Center Incubator, playing a critical role in driving the transformational shift toward next-generation Direct current data center architectures. Working closely with strategic customers - especially hyperscalers - you will help shape the future of data center architectures by translating complex customer challenges into innovative, optimized electrical solutions.

In this highly visible role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor across the full project lifecycle, combining deep technical expertise with strong consultative skills. You will influence market opportunities, support customer adoption, reduce churn, and enable flawless execution of pioneering Direct Current data center projects.

The work model for the role is: hybrid (#LI hybrid)

This position reports solid line to the Solid State Transformer Program Manager and dotted line to the Direct Current Datacenter Incubator Manager.

Key • Responsibilities

  • In collaboration with ABB data center segment and account managers partners closely with key customers - particularly hyperscalers - to support their transition from conventional AC data centers to advanced Direct Current data center architectures.

  • Design and architect end-to-end electrical power system solutions for data centers, delivering competitive, scalable, and future-ready system architectures.

  • Design protection and control— Designing Direct Current ‑specific protection schemes and overall control schemes for the future architecture including sequence of operation, managing the load and active monitoring.

  • Manage customer and market requirements and align the priorities for the product development teams.

  • Collaborate with internal engineering and product teams to identify technology gaps and influence product roadmap evolution.

  • Lead and support pilot projects, ensuring successful early-stage execution and delivery of novel Direct Current data center solutions.

  • Act as a technical authority and customer advocate throughout the sales, design, and delivery phases.

  • Contribute to technical thought leadership in emerging Direct Current power architectures and industry trends.

• Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in power system design, consulting, or solution architecture.

  • Strong background in data center power systems, or exposure to Direct Current power solu-tions (experience in adjacent industries such as marine or industrial Direct Current systems is highly valued).

  • Demonstrated track record of delivering complex, high-impact technical solutions.

  • Knowledge in electrical power systems, including switchgear, transformers, protection, control systems.

  • Ability to operate effectively in evolving technical environments.

  • Willingness to travel internationally, particularly to the United States.

  • Strong Cross-cultural awareness.

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets.

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

We are looking for a Product Quality Engineer with a strong background in power electronics and proven experience in the design and validation of Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS). The Product Quality Engineer plays a pivotal role in collaborating with the R&D department for product design and implementation.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Critical Power, Smart Power division in Quartino, Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Acting as a quality interface between Agile Teams (R&D & Product Management), Operations, and Suppliers to ensure product robustness before the release (G5).

  • Furthermore you will be analyzing test data, quality KPIs, and field return issues and providing critical feedback during the definition of product requirements, influencing design for quality and reliability.

  • Managing quality product validation, according to ABB PCP (Product Creation Process) or equivalent methodologies (e.g., APQP), including test planning, design, and execution.

  • Actively supporting the Design FMEA, Process FMEA, and PPAP activities in cross-functional teams. Additionally, you will contribute to improving Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Testing (DFT), with a focus on PCBA production processes.


You will join a dynamic, talented and high-performing team, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Master’s or Bachelor's Degree in Electronic Engineering.

  • Previous experience in product development as well as 5+ years of experience in the Power Electronics industry, preferably in the UPS sector.

  • Strong expertise in UPS architecture (single-phase and three-phase systems from 10 kW to 2 MW), including both hardware and software is preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with product validation plans, including definition, execution, and analysis of lab test results.

  • Solid knowledge of FMEA, PPAP, PCP/APQP quality tools and methodologies is desired.

  • Deep understanding of PCBA manufacturing processes, including the ability to influence design for testing and manufacturability.

  • Fluent or professional-level English (both spoken and written) with strong team spirit and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your Role & • Responsibilities

We are looking for an innovative and experienced R&D Senior Motor Designer (f/m/d) to play a key role in the development of next-generation motor concepts in the field of linear motor systems. In this role, you will combine deep technical expertise with a passion for innovation and a strong focus on industrialization and series readiness. Working in cross-functional international teams, you will make a significant contribution to our technological leadership and competitiveness.


In this role, you’ll help run what runs the world, by taking on meaningful work that drives real impact.

The work model for the role is: onsite with 10 home office days a month


  • Drive innovation from concept to series production
    Independently design and develop innovative linear motor concepts and validate your solutions using state-of-the-art FEM/CFD simulations and digital twin methodologies.
  • Balance technical performance and cost efficiency
    Apply design-to-cost principles to optimize both product quality and efficiency, while ensuring robust and reliable solutions through FMEA and DVP methods.
  • Turn ideas into manufacturable solutions
    Collaborate closely with procurement, suppliers, and manufacturing to ensure that new materials and concepts can be implemented efficiently and are suitable for industrial production (DFM/DFA).
  • Work across disciplines and functions
    Act as a key technical contributor, partnering closely with experts in power electronics, firmware, and software within globally distributed cross-functional teams.

Our team dynamics

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

What it takes to Run what runs the world

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field from a university or university of applied sciences
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in the design, development, and validation of motors or electromagnetic components
  • Good expertise in FEM/CFD simulation, ideally with ANSYS Maxwell, Motor-CAD, or COMSOL
  • Solid know-how in winding technology, magnet design, tolerance management, and design for manufacturing/assembly (DFM/DFA)
  • Practical experience with quality methods such as FMEA and DVP, as well as industrial product development processes
  • Good working knowledge of CAD systems such as CATIA, Creo, or SolidWorks, as well as PLM platforms and relevant IEC/ISO standards
  • Very good German and English skills
  • A collaborative mindset, eagerness to learn, and a positive attitude

• We offer a full range of benefits to help you thrive at work and beyond:

  • Work-Life Balance – Flexible working models, including flextime and hybrid options, to support your personal and professional life.
  • Health & Well-being – Access to various health measures, a Global Employee Assistance Program, and a gender-neutral parental leave policy.
  • Financial Perks – Participation in the Global Employee Shareholder Acquisition Program (ESAP) and meal allowances.
  • Career Growth – Extensive training opportunities and structured development programs to help you advance.
  • Inclusive Culture – An international work environment that encourages collaboration and innovation.

But we would be pleased to speak in person about your compensation package in relation to your qualifications and experience!

ABB’s Machine Automation division delivers automation solutions and services for machine and factory applications across industries such as consumer-packaged goods, printing, life sciences, plastics, energy and maritime. descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your Role & • Responsibilities

We are looking for an innovative and experienced R&D Senior Motor Designer (f/m/d) to play a key role in the development of next-generation motor concepts in the field of linear motor systems. In this role, you will combine deep technical expertise with a passion for innovation and a strong focus on industrialization and series readiness. Working in cross-functional international teams, you will make a significant contribution to our technological leadership and competitiveness.


In this role, you’ll help run what runs the world, by taking on meaningful work that drives real impact.

The work model for the role is: onsite with 10 home office days a month


  • Drive innovation from concept to series production
    Independently design and develop innovative linear motor concepts and validate your solutions using state-of-the-art FEM/CFD simulations and digital twin methodologies.
  • Balance technical performance and cost efficiency
    Apply design-to-cost principles to optimize both product quality and efficiency, while ensuring robust and reliable solutions through FMEA and DVP methods.
  • Turn ideas into manufacturable solutions
    Collaborate closely with procurement, suppliers, and manufacturing to ensure that new materials and concepts can be implemented efficiently and are suitable for industrial production (DFM/DFA).
  • Work across disciplines and functions
    Act as a key technical contributor, partnering closely with experts in power electronics, firmware, and software within globally distributed cross-functional teams.

Our team dynamics

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

What it takes to Run what runs the world

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field from a university or university of applied sciences
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in the design, development, and validation of motors or electromagnetic components
  • Good expertise in FEM/CFD simulation, ideally with ANSYS Maxwell, Motor-CAD, or COMSOL
  • Solid know-how in winding technology, magnet design, tolerance management, and design for manufacturing/assembly (DFM/DFA)
  • Practical experience with quality methods such as FMEA and DVP, as well as industrial product development processes
  • Good working knowledge of CAD systems such as CATIA, Creo, or SolidWorks, as well as PLM platforms and relevant IEC/ISO standards
  • Very good German and English skills
  • A collaborative mindset, eagerness to learn, and a positive attitude

• We offer a full range of benefits to help you thrive at work and beyond:

  • Work-Life Balance – Flexible working models, including flextime and hybrid options, to support your personal and professional life.
  • Health & Well-being – Access to various health measures, a Global Employee Assistance Program, and a gender-neutral parental leave policy.
  • Financial Perks – Participation in the Global Employee Shareholder Acquisition Program (ESAP) and meal allowances.
  • Career Growth – Extensive training opportunities and structured development programs to help you advance.
  • Inclusive Culture – An international work environment that encourages collaboration and innovation.

Austria: The minimum compensation, in accordance with the electrical and electronics industry collective agreement, is € 4.472,11 - 4.905,47 monthly for a full-time position as of May 2026. But we would be pleased to speak in person about your compensation package in relation to your qualifications and experience!

More about us: Machine Automation, ABB
ABB’s Machine Automation division delivers automation solutions and services for machine and factory applications across industries such as consumer-packaged goods, printing, life sciences, plastics, energy and maritime. With its B&R’s product portfolio, the division delivers integrated control and software, motion control, mechatronics, and machine automation technologies designed to simplify processes and optimize factory operations.

Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.

Run What Runs the World.

#ABBcareers #LI-Hybrid #RunwithABB #Runwhatrunstheworld

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

R&D Team Lead

Votre rôle & • Responsabilités

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un designer moteur senior R & D innovant et expérimenté (h/f/d) pour jouer un rôle clé dans le développement de concepts moteurs de nouvelle génération dans le domaine des systèmes moteurs linéaires. Dans ce rôle, vous combinerez une expertise technique approfondie avec une passion pour l'innovation et un accent fort sur l'industrialisation et la préparation aux séries. En travaillant dans des équipes internationales interfonctionnelles, vous apporterez une contribution importante à notre leadership technologique et à notre compétitivité.


Dans ce rôle, vous allez aider à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde, en prenant un travail significatif qui entraîne un impact réel.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est: sur place avec 10 jours de bureau à domicile par mois

    Concevoir et développer des concepts de moteurs linéaires novateurs et valider vos solutions à l'aide de simulations FEM/CFD ultramodernes et de méthodologies numériques jumelles.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Marketing & Sales Leader - ELSB/ELSP

__

As Sales Manager - Panel Builders, you will lead one of ABB Electrification's key sales channels in Switzerland. Combining strategic leadership with a strong customer focus, you will drive profitable growth, strengthen long-term customer relationships, and lead a high-performing sales team. Working closely with colleagues across the business, you will play an important role in shaping our commercial success while helping customers accelerate the transition to a more sustainable and electrified future.

The working model is: LI-Hybrid

Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Lead, coach, and develop the local Panel Builders sales team, fostering a high-performance, customer-centric culture and ensuring strong market coverage across all regions of Switzerland.

  • Drive profitable growth by identifying new business opportunities and implementing effective sales, market segmentation, and pricing strategies aligned with ABB’s business objectives.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and partners, ensuring an excellent customer experience throughout the entire sales process.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product marketing, operations, and other stakeholders to support business success, while coordinating sales information flow, providing accurate forecasts and market insights, and managing commercial and contractual risks.

What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree or similar in a technical field (preferably Electrical Engineering) with minimum 3 years of successful sales leadership background with a proven track record in the Swiss market.

  • Demonstrated people leadership experience and solid cross-functional collaboration and teamwork skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across functions and organizational levels.

  • Good technical knowledge of energy distribution and low-voltage switchgear or similar technical field. Furthermore, ability and interest to sell and promote digital solutions.

  • Sound understanding of contract negotiations, risk management, and commercial and legal terms.

  • Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, a customer-focused mindset, and a professional, proactive "can-do" attitude.

  • Fluent in German, with a good command of French and English.

More about us:

Electrification offers technologies across the entire electrification value chain—from the substation to the point of consumption. In doing so, it contributes to a secure and reliable power supply. The portfolio includes digital and connected innovations that improve the reliability and efficiency of low- and medium-voltage electrical installations. These include electric vehicle charging infrastructure, modular substations, distribution automation solutions, switchgear, sensor technology and control systems, as well as KNX systems for the automation and networking of building infrastructure.

This recruitment process is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Acquisition Partner, ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Marketing & Sales Leader - ELSB/ELSP

__

As Sales Manager - Panel Builders, you will lead one of ABB Electrification's key sales channels in Switzerland. Combining strategic leadership with a strong customer focus, you will drive profitable growth, strengthen long-term customer relationships, and lead a high-performing sales team. Working closely with colleagues across the business, you will play an important role in shaping our commercial success while helping customers accelerate the transition to a more sustainable and electrified future.

The working model is: LI-Hybrid

Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Lead, coach, and develop the local Panel Builders sales team, fostering a high-performance, customer-centric culture and ensuring strong market coverage across all regions of Switzerland.

  • Drive profitable growth by identifying new business opportunities and implementing effective sales, market segmentation, and pricing strategies aligned with ABB’s business objectives.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and partners, ensuring an excellent customer experience throughout the entire sales process.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product marketing, operations, and other stakeholders to support business success, while coordinating sales information flow, providing accurate forecasts and market insights, and managing commercial and contractual risks.

What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree or similar in a technical field (preferably Electrical Engineering) with minimum 3 years of successful sales leadership background with a proven track record in the Swiss market.

  • Demonstrated people leadership experience and solid cross-functional collaboration and teamwork skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across functions and organizational levels.

  • Good technical knowledge of energy distribution and low-voltage switchgear or similar technical field. Furthermore, ability and interest to sell and promote digital solutions.

  • Sound understanding of contract negotiations, risk management, and commercial and legal terms.

  • Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, a customer-focused mindset, and a professional, proactive "can-do" attitude.

  • Fluent in German, with a good command of French and English.

More about us:

Electrification offers technologies across the entire electrification value chain—from the substation to the point of consumption. In doing so, it contributes to a secure and reliable power supply. The portfolio includes digital and connected innovations that improve the reliability and efficiency of low- and medium-voltage electrical installations. These include electric vehicle charging infrastructure, modular substations, distribution automation solutions, switchgear, sensor technology and control systems, as well as KNX systems for the automation and networking of building infrastructure.

This recruitment process is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Acquisition Partner, ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Team Manager – Industrial Software Research

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a research scientist in Software Systems Engineering, you will be working on the future architecture and design of ABB’s software-based products, with a special focus on the digitalization of industrial systems. We are looking for a team member with a proven research track record and the eagerness to transfer and apply world class academic research into an industrial environment. You will work within the highly motivated, international team of scientists at ABB Research. • We offer an open and innovative international work environment with many diverse opportunities to grow your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contribute to and/or lead research projects that turn state-of-the-art research results into effective software solutions for ABB.

  • Create prototypes of innovative concepts with real business impact

  • Evaluate new technologies and assess their impact on ABB products and roadmaps.

  • Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports.

  • Build a network in the company and actively disseminate your knowledge and expertise.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or in a related field

  • Experience in software engineering and system design

  • Theoretical and practical knowledge in one or multiple of the following topics: software engineering, distributed systems, computer networking, embedded systems, machine learning, cyber security

  • Hands-on experience in programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, Rust)

  • Proven publication track record at top scientific conferences and journals

  • Excellent communication skills and team player attitude

  • Solid experience of getting ideas from concepts to prototypes



Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Flexible Work Practices

  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan

  • Canteen

More about us


At the ABB Research Center located in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on cutting-edge technologies that shape the future of our products. The Industrial Software Systems research team explores topics like machine learning, cybersecurity, computer networking, distributed systems, and real-time systems. Our solutions are used to support the development of next-generation digital products and services of ABB.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

This recruitment process is managed by Pedro Labian, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.

What's in it for you:

We empower you to take initiative, explore new possibilities, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Applied Physicist (80 - 100%) f/m/d
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Power Device Physics

__


Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Conducting applied research in the area of power device physics with focus on dielectric insulation, breakdown phenomena, and other multi-physics topics

  • Contributing to and leading research projects towards sustainable solutions for the upcoming energy transformation, integration of renewable energies and energy storage systems

  • Applying commercial and in-house developed advanced simulation tools

  • Planning, setting up, and executing scientific experiments

  • Driving research activities, generating intellectual property, and writing scientific publications

  • Closely cooperating with scientists and engineers within the team, driving collaborations within the research center, with universities, and global ABB divisions

In this role, as a member of the Power Device Physics team, within Energy Technologies department, you work on the broad portfolio of ABB devices and systems from longer-term fundamental research up to time-critical questions in products. You provide novel and innovative solutions in the field of dielectric insulation in gases and solids with overlap to other multi-physical topics. Translating your findings from basic research on physical phenomena to prototypes demonstrating the technologies, you contribute to evolving applications in such fields as protection systems for sustainable energy generation and distribution. To achieve this, you utilize state-of-the-art simulations, perform scientific experiments, and apply the results to technology development and expert support of ABBs business divisions.


Reporting to the research team manager, you will engage with cross-functional teams inside and outside the company, contribute to the definition of the team research roadmap, and to the management of the research projects.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in physics or electrical engineering, background in dielectric is a plus (please submit a list of publications if available).

  • Hands-on experience in a scientific or industrial laboratory, a willingness to work independently and take initiatives in designing, building, and testing prototypes

  • Experience in simulations, e.g., COMSOL

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach with good ability to build and maintain work relationships

  • Strong communication and presentation skills in English (both written and spoken)

​More about us

The Power Device Physics Team at the ABB research center in Switzerland conducts interdisciplinary research focusing on multi-physical phenomena related to the broad portfolio of ABB's devices and systems, including switchgear and power electronics. The team consists of enthusiastic scientists and engineers whose activities span from deepening the knowledge of physical phenomena such as dielectric breakdowns in gases/solids/vacuum, or thermal management with novel cooling concepts, to solving questions directly related to ABB's product portfolio. Our expertise and solutions are used to enable and support the development of next-generation products. This unique opportunity allows you to carry out research in an evolving field and to contribute with your expertise to ABB’s success by reinforcing our team. If you are passionate about science and technology and want to work in an inspiring environment where your skills and ideas become part of solutions for a sustainable future, then apply now.


This recruitment process is managed by Pedro Labian, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Technical Service Specialist - Gearless Mill Drive (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Engineering Manager - GMD

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will ensure the effective delivery of the Service portfolio according to ABB's standard processes and safety guidelines, ensuring customer satisfaction. Each day, you will provide technical support, act as a specialist, and solve problems within your area of expertise. You will also leverage your expertise by proactively communicating with both customers and ABB service sales and life cycle management teams to understand customer needs and capitalize on business opportunities for service growth. The role includes on-site assignments up to 40% of the time.

The work model for the role is: LI-Hybrid

This role contributes to the Business Line Mining & Materials in a global leadership role for the anchor product GMD (Gearless Mill Drive). Main stakeholders include customers, internal service sales and life cycle management teams, and other engineering disciplines.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Providing technical support and solving problems via remote or on-site service, including installation and commissioning, maintenance, repairs, trouble shooting, back-office engineering and consulting, retrofit engineering, etc.

  • Investigating customer needs through professional consulting. Additionally, managing customer relationships and maintaining regular contact with key customers and acting as 24/7 support line for one complete week, approx. every two months, depending on availability.

  • Proactively suggesting product and quality improvements and communicating them within the ABB organization.

  • Providing technical consulting on Service solutions to management and customers. You will join a truly international and dynamic team, where you will be able to thrive.

• Qualifications for the role

  • A bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering or any related field.

  • Proven experience as an electrical engineer, product specialist or in a similar technical role, preferably within the power electronics sector.

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach with effective communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, enabling seamless collaboration across departments and with customers.

  • Attention to detail, ensuring product conformity, accurate technical documentation, and adherence to quality standard.

  • Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in other languages such as Spanish is a plus.

More about us

GREAT MINDS, GREAT MINES From cellphones, electric vehicles, batteries, wind farms…virtually every aspect of modern life relies on the ores mined from the earth. But there must be a transformation. The demand for minerals has increased significantly, making sustainable, safe, and productive mining more crucial than ever. ABB’s GMD is the most powerful mill drive system in the market to power semi autogenous (SAG), ball and autogenous (AG) mills. This ’workhorse’ for grinding operations combines a robust, service-friendly, and fit-for-purpose design to provide the highest throughput, reliability, and availability for your processing plant.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Unit Lead

__

At ABB’s Research Center in Baden-Dättwil, Switzerland, we explore new technologies that support and drive the development of ABB’s next-generation products and solutions.


The Industrial Solutions department is organized into four research teams that collaborate closely with development teams across ABB’s various divisions. Our research activities cover a broad range of fields, including Power Electronics (converter topologies, control, EMC, and reliability), Industrial Software (cybersecurity, ML/AI, real-time embedded systems, and connected systems), as well as Sensing & Analytics (sensor technologies, perception, and electronics).


This is a unique opportunity for a leader who is passionate about combining people management with the strategic alignment of an R&D department, while also overseeing operational aspects such as work safety, R&D processes, and stakeholder management.

Your main responsibilities include

  • Lead and represent the department with 45 members: people management (recruitment, development), support of project portfolio management and research strategy, continuous improvement of processes and lab infrastructure

  • Support the Research Center Management Team as active member, including the coordination of global R&D activities

  • Guarantee professional, top quality definition and execution of R&D projects

  • Contribute to extend the technical and process knowledge to the organization with special focus on HSE topics

• Qualifications for the role

  • Experience in leading an R&D group or an R&D department

  • Communication and leadership skills

  • PhD in physics, electrical engineering, computer science, chemistry or a similar R&D track record

  • Knowledge of at least two of the core topics described above, combined with a willingness and ability to develop knowledge in other areas

  • Experience with the development process for industrial products

  • Track record in delivering market-oriented R&D results

  • Fluency in English and basic knowledge of German


More about us
• We offer an inspiring international environment, the opportunity to influence breakthrough technologies with real-world impact, and excellent prospects for professional and leadership development.

jobs.title: Head of Trade & Structured Finance
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Head of Treasury


Reporting to the Corporate Treasurer of ABB Robotics, you will own and lead the Trade & Structured Finance function for the standalone company. You will be accountable for the full bank guarantee portfolio and facilities, and for developing the structured finance, receivables and supply chain finance solutions that optimize working capital and unlock liquidity for the business. You will design the operating model, systems and controls that support these activities, drive automation and AI across trade processes, and partner commercially with the business and banking market. Supported by a Trade Finance Specialist, and working closely with Treasury leadership, Finance, Legal, the business and banking partners, you will build and run a scalable, independent trade finance capability.

The work model for the role is hybrid; #LI-hybrid

The location of the role is within Europe

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Trade finance leadership & ownership: Owning the Trade & Structured Finance function end to end – setting strategy, standards and policy and acting as the accountable owner for guarantees, structured finance and working capital solutions across the group.

  • Bank guarantees & instruments: Owning the full guarantee portfolio and facilities – bank guarantees, parent company guarantees, surety bonds and standby letters of credit – including facility negotiation, the day-to-day lifecycle (issuance, amendment, extension, reduction, renewal, cancellation, claims), and guarantee fee management.

  • Guarantee operating model & systems: Owning the operating model and system solution for guarantee management: a structured process for subsidiary requests, tracking and approval, electronic transmission to banks, and record keeping (Komgo)

  • Structured finance, AR factoring & supply chain finance: Developing and implementing receivables (AR) factoring based on business requirements, supply chain / payables finance and structured trade finance solutions to optimize working capital and release liquidity; assessing feasibility, structuring programs, negotiating with providers, and ensuring correct documentation and accounting treatment.

  • Bank relationships: Managing trade finance banking relationships and the wider counterparty set; leading new bank onboarding, account opening and KYC / AML processes, and negotiating commercial terms and limits.

  • Covenants, controls & governance: Owning covenant monitoring and lender reporting for the trade finance perimeter, and establishing the internal controls, governance and compliance framework for the function.

  • AI & automation of trade processes: Driving automation and AI across the trade finance process – from request intake and issuance to tracking, reconciliation and reporting – leveraging the Trade Finance System and ERP (SAP S4), analytics and emerging tooling to build a low-touch, scalable operation.

  • Commercial partnering: Partnering with the business on tenders, bids and contracts, providing guarantee and financing solutions that support commercial wins while protecting the group’s risk and liquidity position.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Extensive treasury experience in global, multinational companies, with a strong track record leading trade finance and bank guarantee management.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise across guarantee instruments – bank guarantees, PCGs, surety bonds, standby letters of credit – including facility negotiation and guarantee-wording review.

  • Solid knowledge of structured finance, receivables (AR) factoring and supply chain / payables finance, including program structuring, provider negotiation and the accounting implications.

  • Practical experience of bank onboarding, KYC / AML, covenant frameworks and lender reporting in a multi-entity, multi-country context.

  • Experience applying AI and / or automation to trade finance processes.

  • A dynamic, highly agile and commercially aware professional with a strong ownership mindset, who thrives in fast-moving, international environments; carve-out or standalone build experience is an advantage.

En vous joignant à nous maintenant, vous ferez partie d'une équipe pionnière qui façonnera l'avenir de la robotique, travaillant aux côtés d'experts de calibre mondial dans un environnement dynamique et axé sur l'innovation. Ce poste relève :

Chef du Trésor


Sous l'autorité du Trésorier d'ABB Robotics, vous serez propriétaire et directeur de la fonction Trade & Structured Finance pour l'entreprise autonome. Vous serez responsable de l'ensemble du portefeuille et des facilités de garantie bancaire, ainsi que du développement des solutions de financement structuré, de créances et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement qui optimisent le fonds de roulement et libèrent des liquidités pour l'entreprise. Vous concevrez le modèle d'exploitation, les systèmes et les contrôles qui soutiennent ces activités, stimuleront l'automatisation et l'IA dans tous les processus commerciaux et établirez des partenariats commerciaux avec le marché des affaires et des services bancaires. Avec l'appui d'un spécialiste des finances commerciales et en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants de la Trésorerie, les Finances, les Services juridiques, les partenaires commerciaux et bancaires, vous créerez et gérerez une capacité évolutive et indépendante de financement du commerce.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est hybride; #LI-hybrid

L'emplacement du rôle est en Europe

Vous serez principalement responsable :

  • Leadership et propriété du financement commercial: La fonction Commerce et finances structurées prend fin – établir une stratégie, des normes et des politiques et agir comme propriétaire responsable des garanties, des finances structurées et des solutions de fonds de roulement dans l'ensemble du groupe.

  • Garanties et instruments bancaires: Posséder l'intégralité du portefeuille et des facilités de garantie – garanties bancaires, garanties des sociétés mères, cautions et lettres de crédit – y compris la négociation des facilités, le cycle de vie quotidien (émission, modification, extension, réduction, renouvellement, annulation, réclamations) et la gestion des frais de garantie.

  • Modèle et systèmes d'exploitation de la garantie: Posséder le modèle d'exploitation et la solution du système pour la gestion de la garantie: un processus structuré pour les demandes subsidiaires, le suivi et l'approbation, la transmission électronique aux banques et la tenue de dossiers (Komgo)

  • Financement structuré, affacturage des EI et financement de la chaîne d'approvisionnement: Élaboration et mise en oeuvre de l'affacturage des créances (AR) en fonction des besoins des entreprises, des finances de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et des créditeurs et des solutions de financement du commerce structuré afin d'optimiser le fonds de roulement et de libérer la liquidité; évaluation de la faisabilité, structuration des programmes, négociation avec les fournisseurs, et garantie d'une documentation et d'un traitement comptables corrects.

  • Relations bancaires: Gérer les relations avec les banques de financement commercial et l'ensemble plus large des contreparties; diriger les nouveaux processus d'embarquement, d'ouverture de compte et de CYK/MLA, et négocier les modalités et les limites commerciales.

  • Provêtements, contrôles et gouvernance: La surveillance de l'alliance et les rapports des prêteurs pour le périmètre du financement du commerce, et l'établissement du cadre de contrôle interne, de gouvernance et de conformité pour la fonction.

  • AI et l'automatisation des processus commerciaux: L'automatisation et l'IA dans l'ensemble du processus du financement du commerce - de la réception et de l'émission des demandes au suivi, au rapprochement et à l'établissement des rapports - tirer parti du système de financement du commerce et du PGI (SAP S4), de l'analyse et de l'outillage émergent pour construire une opération à faible toucher et évolutive.

  • Partenaire commercial: Partenariat avec l'entreprise sur les appels d'offres, les soumissions et les contrats, fournissant des solutions de garantie et de financement qui soutiennent les gains commerciaux tout en protégeant le risque et la position de liquidité du groupe.

  • Expertise approfondie et pratique des instruments de garantie – garanties bancaires, PCG, obligations de garantie, lettres de crédit en attente – y compris la négociation d'installations et l'examen de la formulation de la garantie.

  • Connaissance solide en matière de financement structuré, d'affacturage des créances et de financement de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et des créditeurs, y compris la structuration des programmes, la négociation des fournisseurs et les répercussions comptables.

  • Expérience pratique de la banque à bord, de la KYC et de l'AML, des cadres d'alliance et des rapports des prêteurs dans un contexte multi-entités, multi-pays.

jobs.description:

This position reports to:

Regional Sales Manager Europe for Excitation & Hydropower

__

Job • Profile Summary

Implements the sales strategy and drives the respective sales process in Hydropower and industries in collaboration with the Local Division Sales Manager and the Business Line Sales Manager Europe. Generates sales opportunities and secures profitable sales for ABB’s Energy Industries Division and its Business Line Power Reliability in Switzerland. Builds long-term customer relationships and ensures immediate response to specific customer needs and issues.


Core • Responsibilities

  • Strong solution selling and value proposition creation abilities, cybersecurity and digital solutions acumen.

  • Strong understanding of project dynamics and Installed Base (IB) concepts and confidently promoting value‑adding solutions.

  • Skilled in identifying, developing, and securing sales opportunities based on customer needs and market trends.

  • Customer-focused mindset with strong communication and negotiation skills, building long‑term customer relationships and responding quickly and professionally to customer issues.

Baut langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und gewährleistet eine schnelle und professionelle Reaktion auf spezifische Kundenanforderungen und Anliegen.

Qualifikationen

  • Erfahrung in Business Development, technischem Vertrieb oder im Angebots- und Ausschreibungsmanagement, idealerweise in den Bereichen Energieerzeugung, Automatisierung, Elektrifizierung oder Industrie.

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Lösungsvertrieb und in der Entwicklung überzeugender Kundennutzenargumentationen sowie Kenntnisse im Bereich Cybersecurity und digitaler Lösungen.

  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Projektdynamiken und Installed-Base-Konzepten sowie die Fähigkeit, wertschöpfende Lösungen überzeugend zu positionieren.

  • Erfahrung in der Identifikation, Entwicklung und erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Vertriebschancen auf Basis von Kundenbedürfnissen und Markttrends.

  • Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie starke Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten mit Fokus auf den Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen und eine schnelle, professionelle Bearbeitung von Kundenanliegen.

  • Reisebereitschaft von bis zu 50 %.

Résumé du poste

Met en œuvre la stratégie commerciale et pilote le processus de vente correspondant dans les secteurs de l’hydroélectricité et de l’industrie, en collaboration avec le Responsable commercial local de la division et le Business Line Sales Manager Europe. Génère des opportunités commerciales et assure des ventes rentables pour la division Energy Industries d’ABB et sa Business Line Power Reliability en Suisse. Développe des relations clients durables et garantit une réponse rapide aux besoins et problématiques spécifiques des clients.

Responsabilités principales

  • Se concentre sur les nouveaux projets Greenfield ainsi que sur le développement de la base installée (Installed Base, IB) et des projets Brownfield. Commercialise l’ensemble du portefeuille de solutions (automatisation, systèmes d’excitation, protection, électrification, études de conformité aux codes réseau et solutions numériques) en collaboration avec les autres unités d’ABB.

  • Vend l’ensemble du portefeuille de solutions afin de renforcer la présence d’ABB en Suisse et agit en tant qu’ambassadeur commercial des produits et solutions ABB lors d’activités marketing (campagnes, salons professionnels, expositions, conférences et rendez-vous clients).

  • Établit des relations clients à long terme en comprenant leurs exigences et en les traduisant en offres et solutions ABB pertinentes.

  • Comprend la stratégie de vente indirecte et la politique tarifaire associée. Prépare les plans de vente, les analyse et propose des plans d’actions correctifs lorsque cela est nécessaire.

• Qualifications requises

  • Expérience en développement commercial, vente technique ou gestion des offres et appels d’offres, idéalement dans les secteurs de la production d’énergie, de l’automatisation, de l’électrification ou de l’industrie.

  • Solides compétences en vente de solutions et en création de propositions de valeur, ainsi qu’une bonne compréhension des enjeux liés à la cybersécurité et aux solutions numériques.

  • Excellente compréhension des dynamiques de projet et des concepts liés à la base installée (IB), avec la capacité de promouvoir avec assurance des solutions à forte valeur ajoutée.

  • Aptitude à identifier, développer et concrétiser des opportunités commerciales sur la base des besoins des clients et des tendances du marché.

  • Forte orientation client, excellentes compétences en communication et en négociation, avec une capacité à construire des relations durables et à répondre rapidement et professionnellement aux demandes des clients.

  • Disponibilité pour des déplacements professionnels pouvant atteindre 50 % du temps.

  • Maîtrise courante de l’allemand et de l’anglais ; la connaissance d’autres langues, notamment le français, constitue un atout.

More about us

ABB’s Energy Industries Division is enabling safe, smart, and sustainable projects and operations for businesses across the oil, gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation, and water sectors. Driving integrated solutions that automate, digitalize, and electrify operations across industries. The division strives to connect our people and technology capabilities, along with our robust global execution capacity and widespread service footprint to help customers adapt and succeed. With over 50 years of domain expertise, we continue to innovate and reshape traditional approaches across the energy sector with our technologies, that are designed to improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, decrease energy consumption and waste.

Our Benefits

  • Attractive compensation including bonus, 13th-month salary, and participation programs (ESAP).

  • Career development through targeted training and development opportunities.

  • REKA checks for leisure and travel.

  • Company holidays between Christmas and New Year.

  • Various discounts on sports equipment, electronics, and health & wellness offers.

  • Contribution toward gym membership.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

This position reports to:

Regional Sales Manager Europe for Excitation & Hydropower

  • Understands the channel strategy and the establishment of related prices and prepares sales plan, reviews them, and proposes recovery plan(s) when needed.

  • Experience in business development, technical sales or bids and proposals, ideally within the power generation, automation, electrification, or industrial sectors.

  • Reisebereitschaft von bis zu 50 %.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; weitere Sprachen, insbesondere Französisch, sind von Vorteil.

jobs.title: Global Early Talent Program (GETP) – Strategy and M&A
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Head of Strategic Intelligence

__

As Global Early Talent Program participant within Strategy and M&A, you will get hands-on responsibility from the start. You will rapidly build your skills and experience through a series of exciting, cross-functional, and international assignments. Corporate Strategy and M&A is responsible for ABB’s corporate strategy, strategic planning and portfolio management processes as well as execution of acquisitions and divestments.

You will create a legacy to be proud of as you deepen your leadership competences and soft skills, building a strong network within ABB.

The exceptional people you work with, the challenging projects you tackle and the global scale of our business will give the experience you need to build a world-class career in strategy and M&A.

For this particular position, you will be hired within the Corporate Strategy and M&A function in Zurich, Switzerland, with rotations in the Motion Business Area in Switzerland and Finland.

Program start date is October 2026.

The program is made up of three assignments over the course of 24 months:

1) One assignment in Zurich within the Corporate Strategy and M&A function with a strong focus on Strategic Intelligence starting on 1 October 2026 as an introduction to the company.

2) One assignment in business strategy abroad to get an overview of ABB’s business in a different environment/role, and work on an exciting assignment with a different team, expanding your network.

3) One or two assignments in business strategy, M&A or related teams back in Zurich with Motion, where you will deepen your knowledge of the company and your function, strengthening your technical and soft skills.

During the last assignment, participants will meet in Zurich, Switzerland, for a week of training, focused on leadership competencies development. The last rotation will also be the time where the participants start to look for their first permanent position, to be started after the end of the program. All program trainings are meant to build the foundations of your future career evolution.

• Your responsibilities

Depending on the assignment role you will be in, most common responsibilities include:

  • Get involved throughout the entire strategic cycle spanning from diagnosis, market and competitor analysis, strategic modelling and planning to portfolio management and M&A activities as well as performance management

  • Provide regular macroeconomic, market and competitive intelligence updates

  • Contribute to strategy projects – delivering results against partially tight deadlines

  • Support in regular updates on strategy and market insights to the Board of Directors and the Executive Committee

  • Prepare business plans, projected synergies, and valuations

  • Support in the preparation of M&A documentation for ABB decision-making

  • Support during different phases of M&A transactions: planning & preparations, initial assessment, due diligence, contract negotiations, closing preparations, etc.

  • Collaborate with ABB businesses and other functions throughout the M&A process

  • Handle and review acquisition proposals that ABB receives from external parties

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Recent graduate (Master’s level) in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering or related fields

  • Previous initial work experience in relevant fields such as strategy consulting, corporate strategy, M&A, investment banking etc. can be considered

  • Excellent analytical skills – structuring, problem solving, modeling

  • Passion for tackling complex problems, high level of curiosity, eagerness to learn and initiate engagement with others

  • Professional fluency in English, other languages are a plus

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

  • Team spirit and global mindset

  • Attention to detail and accuracy, willing to challenge the status quo and take projects to the next level

  • Eligibility for work permit in Switzerland, e.g., Swiss or EU/EFTA citizen (we will not sponsor a visa application for this role)

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a funzionare più snello e più pulito.E ogni persona qui fa che accada. You.ll essere autorizzato a guidare, sostenuto per crescere, e orgoglioso dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiuta a gestire ciò che gestisce il mondo.

Questa posizione è indirizzata a: Capo dell'intelligence strategica

E' un'idea divertente.

Come partecipante al Global Early Total Program nell'ambito di Strategy e M&A, otterrete sin dall'inizio la responsabilità diretta. Costruirete rapidamente le vostre competenze e la vostra esperienza attraverso una serie di incarichi emozionanti, cross-funzionali e internazionali. La strategia aziendale e M&A è responsabile dei processi di strategia aziendale, pianificazione strategica e gestione del portafoglio di ABB. nonché dell'esecuzione di acquisizioni e cessioni.

Creerai un'eredità di cui essere orgogliosi mentre approfondisci le tue competenze di leadership e le tue competenze soft, costruendo una forte rete all'interno di ABB.

Le persone eccezionali con cui lavori, i progetti impegnativi che affronterai e la scala globale del nostro business daranno l'esperienza necessaria per costruire una carriera di livello mondiale in strategia e M&A.

Per questa particolare posizione, sarete assunti nell'ambito della strategia aziendale e della funzione M&A a Zurigo, Svizzera, con rotazioni nell'area del Motion Business in Svizzera e Finlandia.

La data di inizio del programma è ottobre 2026.

Il programma è composto da tre incarichi nel corso di 24 mesi:

1) Un incarico a Zurigo nell'ambito della strategia aziendale e della funzione M&A con una forte attenzione all'Intelligence strategica a partire dal 1o ottobre 2026 come introduzione alla società.

2) Un incarico nella strategia aziendale all'estero per ottenere una panoramica di ABB.s business in un ambiente / ruolo diverso, e lavorare su un incarico emozionante con un team diverso, espandendo la vostra rete.

3) Uno o due incarichi in strategia aziendale, M&A o team collegati a Zurigo con Motion, dove approfondirete la conoscenza dell'azienda e della vostra funzione, rafforzando le vostre competenze tecniche e morbide.

Durante l'ultima missione, i partecipanti si incontreranno a Zurigo per una settimana di formazione, focalizzata sullo sviluppo delle competenze di leadership. L'ultima rotazione sarà anche il momento in cui i partecipanti inizieranno a cercare la loro prima posizione permanente, da iniziare dopo la fine del programma. Tutti gli allenamenti programma sono destinati a costruire le basi della vostra futura evoluzione professionale.

• Le vostre responsabilità

A seconda del ruolo di assegnazione, le responsabilità più comuni includono:

- Get coinvolto durante tutto il ciclo strategico, dalla diagnosi, analisi di mercato e concorrente, modellazione strategica e pianificazione, alla gestione del portafoglio e delle attività di M&A, nonché alla gestione delle prestazioni

- Fornire aggiornamenti periodici macroeconomici, di mercato e di intelligence competitiva

- Contribuire a progetti strategici.

- Supporto in aggiornamenti periodici sulla strategia e sulle informazioni di mercato al Consiglio di Amministrazione e al Comitato Esecutivo

- Preparare piani aziendali, sinergie previste e valutazioni

- Sostegno alla preparazione della documentazione M&A per il processo decisionale ABB

- Sostegno durante le diverse fasi delle operazioni M&A: pianificazione e preparazione, valutazione iniziale, due diligence, negoziati contrattuali, preparativi di chiusura, ecc.

- dilagarsi con le imprese ABB e altre funzioni durante tutto il processo di M&A

- Gestire e rivedere le proposte di acquisizione che ABB riceve da parti esterne

• Qualifiche per il ruolo:

- Recente laureato (livello Masters) in Finanza, Business Administration, Economia, Ingegneria o campi affini

- Si può prendere in considerazione la precedente esperienza iniziale in settori quali la consulenza strategica, la strategia aziendale, gli investimenti bancari, ecc.

- Eccellenti capacità analitiche, strutturazione, soluzione dei problemi, modellazione

- Passione per affrontare problemi complessi, alto livello di curiosità, voglia di imparare e avviare l'impegno con gli altri

- Fluenza professionale in inglese, altre lingue sono un plus

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e orale

- Spirito di squadra e mentalità globale

- Attenzione ai dettagli e precisione, disposti a sfidare lo status quo e portare i progetti al livello successivo

- Eleggibilità per il permesso di lavoro in Svizzera, ad esempio, cittadino svizzero o UE/EFTA (non sponsorizzeremo una domanda di visto per questo ruolo)

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente richiede ogni tipo di mente: il curioso, il coraggioso e il creativo. Ecco perché accogliamo persone provenienti da ogni provenienza ed esperienza.

Pronto a fare un impatto?

Applica oggi o visita https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.
