descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu werden – und das macht jeder Mensch hier. Sie werden dazu befähigt, zu führen, zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam erzeugen.

Diese Position berichtet an: Leiter der strategischen Intelligenz

Als Global Early Talent Program Teilnehmer bei Strategy und M&A erhalten Sie von Anfang an praktische Verantwortung. Sie werden Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen durch eine Reihe von spannenden, funktionsübergreifenden und internationalen Aufgaben schnell aufbauen. Corporate Strategy und M&A sind verantwortlich für ABB, die Unternehmensstrategie, strategische Planungs- und Portfoliomanagementprozesse sowie die Durchführung von Akquisitionen und Veräußerungen.

Sie werden ein Erbe schaffen, auf das Sie stolz sein können, wenn Sie Ihre Führungskompetenzen und Soft Skills vertiefen und ein starkes Netzwerk innerhalb der ABB aufbauen.

Die außergewöhnlichen Menschen, mit denen Sie arbeiten, die herausfordernden Projekte, die Sie angehen, und das globale Ausmaß unseres Geschäfts werden Ihnen die Erfahrung geben, die Sie brauchen, um eine Weltklasse-Karriere in Strategie und M&A aufzubauen.

Für diese besondere Position werden Sie im Rahmen der Corporate Strategy und M&A-Funktion in Zürich, Schweiz, mit Rotationen im Motion Business Area in der Schweiz und Finnland eingestellt.

Programmstart ist Oktober 2026.

Das Programm besteht aus drei Aufgaben im Laufe von 24 Monaten:

1) Ein Auftrag in Zürich im Rahmen der Corporate Strategy und M&A-Funktion mit einem starken Fokus auf Strategic Intelligence ab dem 1. Oktober 2026 als Einführung in das Unternehmen.

2) Ein Auftrag in der Geschäftsstrategie im Ausland, um einen Überblick über ABB zu bekommen, das Geschäft in einem anderen Umfeld/Role, und an einem spannenden Auftrag mit einem anderen Team arbeiten, Ihr Netzwerk zu erweitern.

3) Ein oder zwei Aufgaben in der Business-Strategie, M&A oder verwandten Teams zurück in Zürich mit Motion, wo Sie Ihre Kenntnisse über das Unternehmen und Ihre Funktion vertiefen, Ihre technischen und weichen Fähigkeiten zu stärken.

Während der letzten Aufgabe treffen sich die Teilnehmer in Zürich, Schweiz, für eine Woche Training, konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung von Führungskompetenzen. Die letzte Rotation wird auch die Zeit sein, wo die Teilnehmer beginnen, ihre erste dauerhafte Position zu suchen, die nach dem Ende des Programms begonnen werden soll. Alle Programm-Trainings sollen die Grundlagen Ihrer zukünftigen Karriereentwicklung aufbauen.

• Ihre Verantwortung

Je nach Aufgabenstellung sind die häufigsten Aufgaben:

- Sich während des gesamten strategischen Zyklus von Diagnose, Markt- und Konkurrenzanalyse, strategischer Modellierung und Planung bis hin zu Portfoliomanagement und M&A-Aktivitäten sowie Performance Management engagieren

- Bereitstellung regelmäßiger makroökonomischer, markt- und wettbewerbsorientierter Nachrichtendienste

- Beitrag zu Strategieprojekten – Ergebnisse liefern gegen teilweise enge Fristen

- Unterstützung bei regelmäßigen Aktualisierungen der Strategie und Markteinblicke für den Verwaltungsrat und die Konzernleitung

- Erstellung von Geschäftsplänen, projizierten Synergien und Bewertungen

- Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von M&A-Dokumenten für ABB-Entscheidungen

- Unterstützung in verschiedenen Phasen der M&A-Transaktionen: Planung & Vorbereitung, Erstbewertung, Due Diligence, Vertragsverhandlungen, Abschlussvorbereitungen usw.

- Zusammenarbeit mit ABB-Unternehmen und anderen Funktionen während des gesamten M&A-Prozesses

- Bearbeitung und Überprüfung von Übernahmeanträgen, die ABB von externen Parteien erhält

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

- Neuer Absolvent (Master, s-Level) in Finanzen, Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder verwandten Bereichen

- Frühere erste Berufserfahrungen in relevanten Bereichen wie Strategieberatung, Unternehmensstrategie, M&A, Investment Banking etc. können berücksichtigt werden

- Ausgezeichnete analytische Fähigkeiten – Strukturierung, Problemlösung, Modellierung

- Leidenschaft für die Bewältigung komplexer Probleme, hohe Neugier, Lernbereitschaft und Initiierung der Auseinandersetzung mit anderen

- Professionelle Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch, andere Sprachen sind ein Plus

- Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

- Teamgeist und globale Denkweise

- Aufmerksamkeit für Detail und Genauigkeit, bereit, den Status quo herauszufordern und Projekte auf die nächste Ebene zu bringen

- Zulassungsvoraussetzungen für Arbeitserlaubnis in der Schweiz, z.B. Schweizer oder EU/EFTA-Bürger (wir werden keinen Visumantrag für diese Rolle sponsern)

Eine sauberere, intelligentere Zukunft zu schaffen, erfordert alle Arten von Gedanken: Neugierige, Mutige und Kreative. Deshalb heißen wir Menschen aus allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen willkommen.

Cette position relève de : Chef du renseignement stratégique

__

En tant que participant au Programme des jeunes talents mondial au sein de la Stratégie et des M&A, vous aurez la responsabilité pratique dès le début. Vous développerez rapidement vos compétences et votre expérience grâce à une série d'affectations passionnantes, interfonctionnelles et internationales. Stratégie et M&A organisationnelles est responsable de l'ABB, de la stratégie organisationnelle, de la planification stratégique et des processus de gestion de portefeuille ainsi que de la réalisation de la construction et des divinations.

Vous créerez un héritage dont vous serez fiers en approfondissant vos compétences en leadership et vos compétences en matière de souplesse, en créant un solide réseau au sein d'ABB.

La date de début du programme est octobre 2026.

Le programme est composé de trois affectations sur une période de 24 mois :

1) Une affectation à Zurich dans le cadre de la fonction Stratégie d'entreprise et M&A avec un accent fort sur le renseignement stratégique à partir du 1er octobre 2026 comme une introduction à l'entreprise.

- Appui à la préparation de documents de fusion et acquisitions pour la prise de décisions ABB

- Soutien durant les différentes phases des opérations de fusion et acquisitions : planification et préparation, évaluation initiale, diligence raisonnable, négociation de contrats, préparation de clôture, etc.

jobs.title: R&D Engineer Firmware (80 -100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

Contributes to ABB's success with technology, software, product, and/or system development. Identifies and implements innovative solutions to relevant problems. Provides ideas and can work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, products, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

Location: Quartino Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Firmware Development: Design, develop, and implement firmware for Power Electronic Converters and communication modules, ensuring robust functionality and cybersecurity
  • Software Quality Assurance: Conduct unit, integration, and system testing to validate software performance and reliability
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with system architects and hardware/software engineers to translate system requirements into detailed firmware specifications
  • Innovation and Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to intellectual property creation and collaborate with global engineering teams to drive continuous improvement and share expertise

• Qualifications for the Role:

  • M.Sc. or B.Sc. degree in Information or Electrical, Power Electronic, Electronic Engineering, Embedded Systems, or comparable field
  • You have at least 3 years of experience in designing control firmware based on microcontrollers / DSPs for Power Electronic Products such as UPS, BESS, Renewable Energy systems
  • You are highly skilled in C/C++/Python and Firmware Development.
  • You have solid knowledge in structured development processes, ranging from requirement analysis, design, and implementation to test and documentation.
  • Experience with development infrastructure, including Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (Git), lifecycle management, build systems, unit testing, debug probes, oscilloscopes, and similar tools
  • Exposure to Cyber Security concepts and knowledge of main industrial communication protocols (Modbus, CAN, EtherCAT) are a plus
  • You are passionate about teamwork and innovation.
  • You are at ease communicating in English and Italian

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

jobs.title: (80 - 100%) R&D Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

As an R&D Senior Engineer, you will leverage your technical expertise to validate and customize OEM single-phase and three-phase low-voltage Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS), ensuring they meet the requirements of mission-critical power protection applications and market specifications.

Reporting to R&D Hardware Chapter Lead, based in Quartino Switzerland, you will contribute significantly to initiatives related to ABB’s Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS) products

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

Location: Quartino Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Lead technical validation and customization of OEM 1ph and 3ph low voltage Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS), as well as batteries and accessories.
  • Manage test partners (UL, Intertek, Dekra, Eurofins, etc.) to scope and plan test programs to demonstrate compliance with applicable IEC or UL standards.
  • Manage the technical specifications of assigned products and support the Product Manager in developing the business case for product development.
  • Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions related to issues found during qualification testing, as well as issues identified at customer sites.
  • Maintain awareness of state-of-the-art technologies and collaborate with the research center in Switzerland and other ABB stakeholders to identify potential new UPS technologies.

• Qualifications for the Role:

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, along with more than five years of professional experience in electrical engineering.
  • Must have experience working with power electronic systems
  • Experience in the use of various measuring equipment in a laboratory environment.
  • Knowledge of product regulations and standards, including IEC and UL.
  • Experience working with external laboratories and certification bodies.
  • Knowledge of ECNs (Engineering Change Notifications), BOMs (Bills of Materials), and documentation systems.
  • Experience with failure investigations and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Knowledge of and experience with Agile methodology is an advantage.
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Critical Power unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

As an R&D Engineer, you will leverage your technical expertise to validate and customize OEM single-phase and three-phase low-voltage Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS), ensuring they meet the requirements of mission-critical power protection applications and market specifications.

Reporting to R&D Hardware Chapter Lead, based in Quartino Switzerland, you will contribute significantly to initiatives related to ABB’s Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS) products

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

Location: Quartino Switzerland

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Lead technical validation and customization of OEM 1ph and 3ph low voltage Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS), as well as batteries and accessories.
  • Manage test partners (UL, Intertek, Dekra, Eurofins, etc.) to scope and plan test programs to demonstrate compliance with applicable IEC or UL standards.
  • Manage the technical specifications of assigned products and support the Product Manager in developing the business case for product development.
  • Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions related to issues found during qualification testing, as well as issues identified at customer sites.
  • Maintain awareness of state-of-the-art technologies and collaborate with the research center in Switzerland and other ABB stakeholders to identify potential new UPS technologies.

• Qualifications for the Role:

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, along with more than two years of professional experience in electrical engineering.
  • Experience working with power electronic systems is required.
  • Experience in the use of various measuring equipment in a laboratory environment.
  • Knowledge of product regulations and standards, including IEC and UL.
  • Experience working with external laboratories and certification bodies.
  • Knowledge of ECNs (Engineering Change Notifications), BOMs (Bills of Materials), and documentation systems.
  • Experience with failure investigations and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Knowledge of and experience with Agile methodology is an advantage.
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Critical Power unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to design, develop, and deliver technical training in person or remotely to participants across the globe. Each day, you will prepare highly qualified ABB and Channel Partner service personnel worldwide, ensuring they are confident in their product knowledge and their ability to commission, service, and maintain Critical Power systems professionally and safely. Your focus will be on HiPerGuard MV UPS, UPS, STS, PDU, PCS, and Battery Systems. You will also showcase your expertise by guaranteeing excellent customer service and securing a high level of customer satisfaction through training.


The work model for the role is: hybrid


In this role, you will contribute to the Critical Power business line in the
Electrification Smart Power division and be based in Quartino, Switzerland. The main stakeholders that support the development and delivery of training are Service, Product Management, Project Management, Engineering, and Sales.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Preparing and delivering training courses in the classroom or on-site

  • Developing course material for classroom and on-site training in your own area of responsibility and advising on updates needed in e-learning material.

  • Supporting the Field Service team and other teams/units, when necessary, by applying your technical expertise to support-related tasks and responsibilities.

  • Supporting course administration by coordinating arrangements and responding to enquiries and requests related to training courses.


Our team dynamics
You will join a dynamic, motivated, and high-performing global team where you
can thrive.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field preferred and a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in service operations, training, engineering, testing, or power quality, with a strong background in electrical and electronic systems.

  • Experience in the power protection field, with roles in Training, Service, R&D, or Sales. Hands-on experience with power protection equipment is desirable.

  • Additional qualifications or certification in adult education or training delivery are preferred.

  • Ability to learn, understand, and apply new technologies.

  • You enjoy working with methodologies for facilitating adult learning and communication. You are self-motivated, possess strong communication skills, and are passionate about fostering effective interpersonal relationships.

Chaque jour, vous préparerez du personnel hautement qualifié de service ABB et Channel Partner dans le monde entier, en s'assurant qu'ils sont confiants dans leurs connaissances du produit et leur capacité à commander, à entretenir et à maintenir les systèmes Critical Power professionnellement et en toute sécurité. Votre attention sera sur HiPerGuard MV UPS, UPS, STS, PDU, PCS et systèmes de batterie. Vous présenterez également votre expertise par garantie d'un excellent service à la clientèle et sécurisation d'un haut niveau de client satisfaction par la formation.


Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : hybride


Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez à la division Critical Power Business line in the
Electrification Smart Power et serez basé dans Quartino, Suisse. Les principaux intervenants qui appuient l'élaboration et la prestation de la formation sont Service, gestion de produits, gestion de projets, génie et ventes.


Vous serez principalement responsable :

  • Préparation et prestation de cours de formation en classe ou sur place

  • Élaborer du matériel de cours pour la formation en classe et sur place dans votre propre zone de responsabilité et donner des conseils sur les mises à jour nécessaires à l'apprentissage en ligne matériel.

  • Appuyer l'équipe du Service mobile et les autres équipes/unités, au besoin, en appliquant votre expertise technique pour appuyer les tâches et les responsabilités liées à la formation.

  • Soutenir l'administration des cours en coordonnant les arrangements et en répondant aux demandes et aux demandes relatives aux cours de formation.


Notre dynamique d'équipe
Vous rejoindrez une équipe mondiale dynamique, motivée et performante où vous pourrez prospérer


• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Baccalauréat en génie électrique ou dans un domaine connexe préféré et un minimum de 3 années d'expérience professionnelle dans les opérations de service, la formation, l'ingénierie, les essais ou la qualité de la puissance, avec une solide expérience dans les systèmes électriques et électroniques.

  • Expérience dans le domaine de la protection du pouvoir, avec des rôles dans la formation, le service, R&D, ou les ventes. L'expérience pratique avec l'équipement de protection de l'alimentation électrique est désirable.

  • Les qualifications supplémentaires ou la certification dans l'éducation des adultes ou la prestation de la formation sont préférées.

  • Capacité d'apprendre, de comprendre et d'appliquer de nouvelles technologies.

  • Vous aimez travailler avec des méthodologies pour faciliter l'apprentissage des adultes et la communication. Vous êtes motivé par vous-même, avez de solides compétences en communication et êtes passionné par la promotion de relations interpersonnelles efficaces.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise de communiquer en anglais.

  • Possibilité de voyager (environ 20%)


Plus d'information sur nous

ABB Smart Power fournit des solutions de distribution d'énergie pour les centres de données, les usines industrielles et manufacturières, les infrastructures essentielles et les bâtiments commerciaux. Les équipes techniques de la Division travaillent en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires de l'industrie, fournissant des solutions avancées qui soutiennent la croissance rapide, la transition énergétique et les objectifs de durabilité. Le portefeuille de la Division comprend des disjoncteurs industriels, des systèmes à basse tension, des applications de démarrage de moteurs et des dispositifs de sécurité comme les commutateurs et les relais. Son unité de protection de l'énergie prend en charge les plus grandes entreprises de centres de données du monde avec des solutions UPS à haut rendement énergétique. Le gestionnaire de l'énergie ABB AptitudeTM fournit une plateforme évolutive et facile à utiliser qui aide les organisations à économiser de l'énergie et à réduire les émissions de CO2.

jobs.title: (80 -100%) Production Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Engineering Manager

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to optimize the Production organization’s assembly methods, processes, and equipment to minimize labor hours in accordance with business strategies related to quality, efficiency, costs, and safety. Each day, you will ensure appropriate production methods, cycle time, equipment performance, work instruction, and materials/components in support of production targets. You will also demonstrate your skills by defining the working phase sequence of a new production process to meet the targeted product cost and equipment investment budget.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to Power Protection

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Identifying and recommending improvement opportunities and implements improvement projects, ensuring adherence to timeframe, quality, and cost requirements.
  • Providing the necessary work instruction
  • Ensure product maintenance through the introduction of the engineering change notice
  • Approving process designs developed internally or externally, performing final project testing, evaluating and implementing new process technologies, and supporting production during process/equipment start-up through action plans, technical guidance, and training of maintenance and production teams.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Degree in Electric/Mechanic Engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience in operation and production line activities.
  • Knowledge of Engineering & Manufacturing Processes.
  • Proficiency in MS Office; preferred are: 2D/3D CAD systems, SAP and Windchill.
  • Proficiency in English and mandatory proficiency in Italian, both spoken and written.
  • Positive spirit, self-motivation, team working, efficiency and problem-solving orientation; focus on delivering results by taking responsibility for assigned tasks and projects

Benefits:

  • Attractive compensation including bonus, 13th-month salary, and participation programs (ESAP).
  • Career development through targeted training and development opportunities.
  • REKA checks for leisure and travel.
  • Company holidays between Christmas and New Year.
  • Various discounts on sports equipment, electronics, and health & wellness offers.
  • Contribution toward gym membership.

More about us:

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

We look forward to receiving your application.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Abschluss in Elektrotechnik/Mechanik.
  • 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in Betriebs- und Produktionslinienaktivitäten.

  • Kenntnisse in MS Office; bevorzugt sind: 2D/3D CAD-Systeme, SAP und Windchill.
  • Englischkenntnisse und obligatorische Italienischkenntnisse, sowohl gesprochen als auch geschrieben.

jobs.title: Service Test Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Principal Technical Support Engineer

__

In this role, you will support the development of hardware and software tools and procedures to ensure consistent and professional commissioning, diagnostics, and maintenance of Critical Power products (UPS, STS, power conditioning). You will analyze technical documentation and system behavior to provide guidance to software developers. You will test the tools at customer sites and in test environments. You will work with field service technicians to fully understand their workflows and identify opportunities to improve their performance.

This role contributes to the Global Service Engineering team. The main stakeholders are the product R&D teams, service software developers, and field service engineers.

You will join a newly formed, rapidly developing, globally focused team where you will be able to thrive.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Analyzing technical documentation to support the developers writing programs that support the field service technician’s jobs.

  • Testing new programs both in test areas and at customer site to ensure they work as expected.

  • Engaging with service technician to train them on the tool and learn from their usage to improve the tool.

  • Writing proposals for new Service applications, equipment, and methods.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • A bachelor’s degree, diploma, or higher academic qualification in Electrical or Electronic Engineering.

  • Several years of hands-on experience in commissioning, after-sales technical support, and advanced diagnostics of UPS, PCS, or energy storage solutions are beneficial.

  • Experience in commissioning and troubleshooting mission-critical applications such as data centers, high-volume industrial facilities, and critical infrastructure installations would be a plus.

  • Proficiency in both verbal and written English communication (B2 level or higher) Knowledge of any other language is a welcome asset.

  • The ability to write clear and concise technical documents, reports, and field support procedures.

  • A willingness to engage directly with clients and teams worldwide, with a travel commitment of up to 50%.

What does ABB have to offer you?

A versatile and varied full-time job of 40 hours within an international concern. ABB likes to invest in your development. • We offer you education, training and growth opportunities. Furthermore, we offer you:

  • a salary appropriate to your knowledge, experience and this position.

  • a thirteenth month.

  • 40 days off (27 holidays and 13 ADV). You have the option of converting part of your leave hours into salary.

  • a lease car.

  • an annual allowance for part of your sports subscription.

  • a good pension scheme.

  • a company phone and laptop.

Are you interested in this world-class job? Then don't wait any longer and apply immediately. Register your CV and apply online at www.abb.nl by clicking on ‘Careers’ . The application process consists of 2 rounds of interviews. For questions, please contact Jacqueline Pereboom, Talent Partner, on 010 - 407 82 14 or soll@nl.abb.com.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Principal Technical Support Engineer

__

In this role, you will support the development of hardware and software tools and procedures to ensure consistent and professional commissioning, diagnostics, and maintenance of Critical Power products (UPS, STS, power conditioning). You will analyze technical documentation and system behavior to provide guidance to software developers. You will test the tools at customer sites and in test environments. You will work with field service technicians to fully understand their workflows and identify opportunities to improve their performance.

This role contributes to the Global Service Engineering team. The main stakeholders are the product R&D teams, service software developers, and field service engineers.

You will join a newly formed, rapidly developing, globally focused team where you will be able to thrive.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Analyzing technical documentation to support the developers writing programs that support the field service technician’s jobs.

  • Testing new programs both in test areas and at customer site to ensure they work as expected.

  • Engaging with service technician to train them on the tool and learn from their usage to improve the tool.

  • Writing proposals for new Service applications, equipment, and methods.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • A bachelor’s degree, diploma, or higher academic qualification in Electrical or Electronic Engineering.

  • Several years of hands-on experience in commissioning, after-sales technical support, and advanced diagnostics of UPS, PCS, or energy storage solutions are beneficial.

  • Experience in commissioning and troubleshooting mission-critical applications such as data centers, high-volume industrial facilities, and critical infrastructure installations would be a plus.

  • Proficiency in both verbal and written English communication (B2 level or higher) Knowledge of any other language is a welcome asset.

  • The ability to write clear and concise technical documents, reports, and field support procedures.

  • A willingness to engage directly with clients and teams worldwide, with a travel commitment of up to 50%.

What does ABB have to offer you?

A versatile and varied full-time job of 40 hours within an international concern. ABB likes to invest in your development. • We offer you education, training and growth opportunities. Furthermore, we offer you:

  • a salary appropriate to your knowledge, experience and this position.

  • a thirteenth month.

  • 40 days off (27 holidays and 13 ADV). You have the option of converting part of your leave hours into salary.

  • a lease car.

  • an annual allowance for part of your sports subscription.

  • a good pension scheme.

  • a company phone and laptop.

ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable and resource-efficient future. Ingénieur principal du soutien technique

jobs.title: (Senior) Scientist for EMC in Power Electronics
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Power Electronic Systems

__

Your role and responsibilities

Our team's mission is to drive innovation at the intersection of power electronic converters and electromagnetics, translating cutting-edge research into next-generation ABB products. We focus on electromagnetic modeling of power converter systems and components, conducted and radiat-ed emissions mitigation, passive and active filtering strategies, and shielding. By joining us, you will shape the future of energy systems — generating pioneering ideas at the frontier of academic research and industrial innovation, while developing transformative technologies that advance ABB's product portfolio.


Are you passionate about enabling a sustainable future through electromagnetics research in pow-er converter systems? We want to hear from you! A dynamic, international team is excited to wel-come you as our newest member. Together, we will push boundaries and make a lasting impact on the energy transition.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Pioneer innovative concepts for ensuring electromagnetic compatibility and interference compliance in high-power converters

  • Develop EMC models to predict and analyze electromagnetic compatibility and optimize electromagnetic design of circuits and systems

  • EMC measurements of conducted and radiated emissions of converters and HF characterization of components

  • Patent innovative solutions and demonstrate technology leadership through e.g., high-impact publications

  • Collaborate closely with ABB research centers, business units, and universities to transition research into real-world applications


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in electrical engineering, physics or related discipline with specialization in power electronics or electromagnetics

  • Proven research excellence demonstrated through high-impact publications and patents

  • Deep technical expertise in:

    • EMC/EMI theory and solid theoretical background in electromagnetic modelling and field simulations

    • Power electronic converter topologies, filters, magnetics, and semiconductor switching devices

    • Simulation tools such as CST, COMSOL, ANSYS, SPICE circuit simulator (LTSpice, SIMetrix), Simulink

  • Hands-on laboratory skills in HF-electromagnetic measurements (conducted and/or radiated emissions), with a proactive, self-driven approach to designing, building, and testing EMC/EMI-compliant power converters. Versatile skill set with the ability to bridge theory and practice across multiple technical domains.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced industrial research environment and deliver results

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Canteen

  • Flexible work practices

  • Childcare


More about us

At the ABB Research Center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

HR Operations Team Lead Payroll, Compensation & Benefits

Your role and responsibilities

In this role you will be a core member of the HR Operational Services Team, based in Baden. You will be responsible for delivering HR Service support to the HR community, business managers and employees. Being part of a motivated and dedicated team of HR Services & Payroll Specialists, you will support in different topics in the area of Payroll, Compensation, Benefits as well as Time & Absence.

  • You are customer-oriented, reliable, and accurate in your work, with strong analytical skills and a natural affinity for numbers.

  • Proficiency in MS Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, OneNote) is required, and experience with Workday and/or SAP HCM is highly desirable.

  • Fluency in German and English is essential, with French and/or Italian language skills considered an additional asset.

  • You hold a current work permit valid in Switzerland (EU/EFTA).

The key purpose of the HR team is to help ABB stand out when it comes to our people - from leadership, performance and talent management to rewards and career opportunity. HR Operations Team Lead Payroll, Compensation & Benefits

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role you will be a core member of the HR Operational Services Team, based in Baden. You will be responsible for delivering HR Service support to the HR community, business managers and employees. Being part of a motivated and dedicated team of HR Services & Payroll Specialists, you will support in different topics in the area of Payroll, Compensation, Benefits as well as Time & Absence.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the human resources in Switzerland. Main stakeholders are HRBPs, HR Service Specialist, Employees, Compensation office, insurance companies.

You will be mainly accountable for:

You will join a customer-orientated and high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Procurement & Logistics Manager

__

Join ABB and help us drive the future of technology. We are seeking a proactive and strategic Procurement Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be crucial in optimizing our supply chain, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring our products remain competitive and sustainable.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly responsible for

  • Designs and implements plans, executes purchasing and logistics strategies to support the business by optimizing costs, quality, delivery and reliability of suppliers and supplied products.

  • Supports the Procurement Manager in implementing effective local sourcing strategies in line with division's strategy to meet current and future business requirements.

  • Applies and implements procurement standards, tools, and processes in their own area of responsibility to secure quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability.

  • Tracks supplier performance Key Performance Indicators, (KPIs), quality issues, procurement processes and activities and creates and updates reports, as required, following the ABB standards.


• Qualifications for the role

  • 5 years of experience in electronics components, passive/active components and PCBAs management.

  • Strong negotiation skills.

  • A degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Proven experience in a procurement, purchasing, or supply chain role, ideally within a technical or manufacturing environment.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience in managing supplier performance and KPIs.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Fluency in English.

Some benefits

  • Flexible working hours

  • Hybrid working

  • ABB - SWIBECO benefits

  • More interesting ABB benefits


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Procurement & Logistics Manager

__

Join ABB and help us drive the future of technology. We are seeking a proactive and strategic Procurement Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be crucial in optimizing our supply chain, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring our products remain competitive and sustainable.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly responsible for

  • Designs and implements plans, executes purchasing and logistics strategies to support the business by optimizing costs, quality, delivery and reliability of suppliers and supplied products.

  • Supports the Procurement Manager in implementing effective local sourcing strategies in line with division's strategy to meet current and future business requirements.

  • Applies and implements procurement standards, tools, and processes in their own area of responsibility to secure quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability.

  • Tracks supplier performance Key Performance Indicators, (KPIs), quality issues, procurement processes and activities and creates and updates reports, as required, following the ABB standards.


• Qualifications for the role

  • 3 - 5 years of experience in electromechanical/electronics components, such as sensors, switches, relays, connectors, fuses, cable-harnesses, passive/active components and/or PCBAs management.

  • Strong negotiation skills.

  • A degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Proven experience in a procurement, purchasing, or supply chain role, ideally within a technical or manufacturing environment.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience in managing supplier performance and KPIs.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Fluency in English.

Some benefits

  • Flexible working hours

  • Hybrid working

  • ABB - SWIBECO benefits

  • More interesting ABB benefits


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Recruitment lead for this position: Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Unterstützt den Beschaffungsmanager bei der Umsetzung effektiver lokaler Beschaffungsstrategien im Einklang mit der Strategie der Division, um aktuelle und zukünftige Geschäftsanforderungen zu erfüllen.

  • Wendet Beschaffungsstandards, Werkzeuge und Prozesse in ihrem eigenen Verantwortungsbereich an, um Qualität, Lieferung, Kosten und Nachhaltigkeit zu sichern.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • 3 - 5 Jahre Erfahrung in elektromechanischen/elektronischen Komponenten, wie Sensoren, Schalter, Relais, Steckverbinder, Sicherungen, Kabel-Harnesses, passive/aktive Komponenten und/oder PCBAs Management.

  • Strong negotiation skills.

  • A degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience in management supplier performance and KPIs.

    ABB Smart Power bietet Energieverteilungslösungen für Rechenzentren, Industrie- und Produktionsanlagen, kritische Infrastrukturen und Geschäftsgebäude. Seine Power Protection-Einheit unterstützt die weltweit größten Rechenzentrumsunternehmen mit fortschrittlichen energieeffizienten USV-Lösungen.     Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

jobs.title: Production Engineering Technician (f/m/d) 80-100%
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Supervisor - Prototype Construction

__

Your Role

In this role, you support the Prototype Construction area in ensuring efficient material supply and coordinating prototype construction processes. You work closely with internal interfaces and make a significant contribution to timely and high-quality prototype manufacturing.


Work Model: On-site

This position supports the Electrification Smart Buildings division, Business Line Energy Distribution, in Schaffhausen.


Your Main • Responsibilities

  • Planning, coordination and implementation of prototype and sample construction orders in close collaboration with Development, Engineering, Production, Quality and SCM
  • Management of production, work and process documentation as well as bill of materials and manufacturing documents (creation, maintenance and updating)
  • Material flow management: ensuring timely material availability for prototypes and pre-series, monitoring material bottlenecks and initiating appropriate measures
  • Process optimization: planning and organization of workflows as well as continuous improvement according to Lean principles

Your • Qualifications

  • Completed technical vocational training
  • 3-5 years of professional experience in an industrial production or engineering environment, ideally in prototype, sample construction or manufacturing
  • Technical understanding and experience reading technical drawings and bill of materials
  • Good knowledge of ERP systems (SAP an advantage) and MS Office applications
  • Enjoyment of collaborating with different departments and coordinating various tasks
  • Strong communication skills with high self-initiative and hands-on mentality
  • Fluent German; English skills are an advantage

What We Offer

We want you to bring your full potential – your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You will receive the tools and freedom to further develop your skills, shape your own path and take on challenges that truly matter. Your work has visible and tangible impact every day.


Benefits

• We offer a range of attractive benefits to support your well-being and work-life balance:

  • REKA vouchers for leisure and travel
  • Company holidays between Christmas and New Year
  • Various health and wellness benefits
  • Gym membership contribution

About Us

ABB Smart Buildings enables the optimization of energy efficiency, security and comfort for every building type through new installations or retrofit solutions. The division offers integrated digital technologies for controlling HVAC, lighting, blinds and security as well as energy distribution solutions, including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial connectors and sockets and conventional cabling accessories, suitable for single-family homes, multi-family residences, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications.

The division's highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve the worldwide increasing demand from real estate developers, owners and investors for intelligent building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to achieve significant sustainable and financial benefits, meet social and environmental requirements while being able to meet even the most complex customer carbon reduction strategies.


This recruitment process is supported by Ece Özen, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities
We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer with a strong background in modern cross-platform mobile development, specifically leveraging Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) and Compose Multiplatform, backed by experience in DevOps, Azure, and Cyber Security.

The successful candidate will play a crucial role in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining cutting-edge applications within the Digital Agile Unit. This role focuses on digital products, covering IoT, cloud platforms, SW Tools, APPs, and Data Management In addition, you will apply AI-assisted and agentic programming practices in daily development activities.

In this role, it is also essential to follow cybersecurity standards, apply appropriate security measures throughout the development process, and comply with ABB’s secure development lifecycle. These practices help ensure that the software released is highly reliable, robust, and secure.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid (#LI-Hybrid)

Key • Responsibilities:

  • Architecture & Development: Designing cross-platform mobile applications using Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) and Compose Multiplatform, optimizing code sharing across Android and iOS without compromising native performance or UI/UX fidelity.
  • AI-Driven Productivity & Agentic Engineering: Championing the adoption of AI pair-programming tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and agentic workflows to streamline code generation, automated unit testing, refactoring, and technical documentation while enforcing human-in-the-loop validation and security.
  • System & Device Integration: Optimizing designs by identifying the best technical solutions, including services, architectural choices, and technical details. Emphasis is placed on seamless integration between software applications and smart devices/hardware via IoT protocols (e.g., Bluetooth LE, MQTT).
  • Agile Collaboration: Applying Scrum methodology (Epics, Features, User Stories, Bugs). Actively participating in Scrum ceremonies and collaborating closely with cross-functional development, UX/UI, and test teams within the Agile unit.
  • CI/CD & Automation: Implementing and maintaining modern CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) tailored for multiplatform targets to ensure efficient release management, automated UI/unit testing, and reliable software delivery.
  • Software Excellence: Ensuring code quality by applying modern architectural patterns (MVI/MVVM, Clean Architecture, Dependency Injection via Koin/Dagger), performing rigorous code reviews, conducting static code analysis, and leveraging static analysis tools (e.g., Detekt, SonarQube).
  • Security & Compliance: Implementing cybersecurity measures by following the Security Development Lifecycle (SDL), ensuring robust data encryption at rest and in transit, secure storage (Keychain/EncryptedSharedPreferences), and meeting defined security requirements throughout development.
  • Local & Cloud Data Management: Designing and optimizing local persistence solutions (e.g., Room, SQLDelight) and managing seamless integration with cloud backends and RESTful/GraphQL APIs.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Degree: Bachelor or master’s degree in electronic/computer science engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Core Mobile Expertise: Solid experience with Kotlin, Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), and Compose Multiplatform (Declarative UI) for iOS/Android target execution.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Hands-on experience using GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent AI-assisted coding tools / LLM agents to accelerate software delivery, prompt-driven prototyping, and code reviews safely and securely.
  • Asynchronous & Reactive Programming: Strong knowledge of Kotlin Coroutines and Flow for concurrent state and stream management.
  • Architecture & Libraries: Deep understanding of modern Android/KMP architecture principles, lifecycle management, state handling, and dependency injection frameworks (e.g., Koin).
  • DevOps & Cloud Integration: Familiarity with cloud environments (particularly Azure) and experience setting up CI/CD pipelines for mobile delivery.
  • API & Connectivity: Hands-on experience with RESTful APIs, modern networking libraries (e.g., Ktor, Retrofit), and IoT device communication protocols (e.g., BLE, Wi-Fi provisioning).
  • Cybersecurity: Strong understanding of mobile security best practices, static analysis tools, and secure data handling under SDL protocols.
  • Methodology: Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
  • Soft Skills: Innovative approach to problem-solving, strong communication skills, and collaborative mindset.
  • Languages: Fluent in English and Italian.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Familiarity with agentic workflows for code automation, spec-to-code generation, and automated PR review bots.
  • Familiarity with Swift/Swift UI for platform-specific iOS bridge integrations.
  • Experience with local database frameworks suitable for KMP (e.g., Room KMP, SQL Delight).
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and monitoring tools.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Questo ruolo si concentra sulle attività di digital products In questo ruolo, è anche essenziale seguire gli standard di sicurezza informatica, applicare adeguate misure di sicurezza durante il processo di sviluppo, e rispettare il ciclo di vita sicuro di sviluppo di ABB. Queste pratiche aiutano a garantire che il software rilasciato sia altamente affidabile, robusto e sicuro. Campione dell'adozione di strumenti di programmazione di coppia AI (ad esempio, GitHub Copilot) Ottimizzazione dei progetti identificando le migliori soluzioni tecniche, inclusi servizi, scelte architettoniche e dettagli tecnici. L'enfasi è posta sull'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità tra applicazioni software e dispositivi intelligenti/hardware tramite protocolli IoT (ad esempio, Bluetooth LE, MQTT). Applicare la metodologia Scrum (Epici, Caratteristiche, Storie utente, Bugs). Partecipano attivamente alle cerimonie Scrum e collaborano strettamente con lo sviluppo interfunzionale, UX/UI e i team di test all'interno dell'unità Agile. Attuazione e mantenimento di moderni gasdotti CI/CD (ad esempio, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) su misura per obiettivi multipiattaforma per garantire efficient release management, UI/unit testing automatizzato e distribuzione software affidabile. Garantire la qualità del codice applicando modelli architettonici moderni (MVI/MVM, Clean Architecture, Dependency Injection via Koin/Dagger), eseguendo rigorose revisioni del codice, conducendo analisi del codice statico e sfruttando strumenti di analisi statica (ad esempio, Detekt, SonarQube). Implementare le misure di sicurezza informatica seguendo il ciclo di vita di sviluppo di sicurezza (SDL), assicurando la crittografia dei dati robusta a riposo e in transito, lo storage sicuro (Keychain/EncryptedSharedPreferences), e soddisfare i requisiti di sicurezza definiti durante lo sviluppo. Progettare e ottimizzare soluzioni di persistenza locale (ad esempio, Room, SQLDelight) e gestire l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità con backend cloud e API RESTful/GraphQL. • Qualifiche per il ruolo: Corso di laurea o master in ingegneria elettronica/informatica, informatica o un campo tecnico correlato. Esperienza solida con Kotlin , Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) e Compose Multiplatform (UI dichiarativa) per l'esecuzione dell'obiettivo iOS/Android. Esperienza pratica con GitHub Copilot, Cursor, o equivalente AI-assistito strumenti di codifica / LLM agenti Comprensione profonda dei moderni principi di architettura Android/KMP, gestione del ciclo di vita, gestione dello stato e sistemi di iniezione di dipendenza (ad esempio, Koin ). Familiarità con gli ambienti cloud (in particolare Azure ) e l'esperienza di creazione di pipeline CI/CD per la consegna mobile. Esperienza pratica con le API RESTful, le librerie di rete moderne (ad esempio, Ktor , Retrofit), e i protocolli di comunicazione dei dispositivi IoT (ad esempio, BLE, Wi-Fi provisioning). Una forte comprensione delle migliori pratiche di sicurezza mobile, degli strumenti di analisi statiche e della gestione sicura dei dati sotto i protocolli SDL. Un approccio innovativo alla risoluzione dei problemi, alle forti capacità di comunicazione e alla mentalità collaborativa. Familiarità con flussi di lavoro agentici per l'automazione del codice, la generazione spec-to-code e robot di revisione PR automatizzati. Esperienza con i framework di database locali adatti a KMP (ad esempio, Room KMP, SQL Delight). I team tecnici della Divisione lavorano a stretto contatto con i partner del settore, offrendo soluzioni avanzate che supportano obiettivi di crescita rapida, transizione energetica e sostenibilità. Il portafoglio della Divisione comprende interruttori industriali, sistemi a bassa tensione, applicazioni di avviamento motore e dispositivi di sicurezza come interruttori e relè. La sua unità Power Protection supporta le più grandi aziende di data center del mondo con soluzioni UPS ad alta efficienza energetica. ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager offre una piattaforma scalabile e facile da usare che consente alle organizzazioni di risparmiare energia e ridurre le emissioni di CO2. Questa opportunità è aperta ai candidati in più paesi, con la posizione di lavoro finale determinata in base al candidato selezionato. Poiché la compensazione può variare in base alla posizione, ci impegniamo ad essere trasparenti durante il processo di assunzione e condividere i dettagli della gamma salariale, il pacchetto di compensazione e benefici variabili con i candidati che progrediscono alla prima fase di intervista per una posizione nell'Unione europea, coperta dalla direttiva UE sulla trasparenza dei pagamenti. L'offerta finale sarà adattata in base alla vostra posizione di ruolo, esperienza, competenze e qualifiche, posizionamento del mercato interno e allineamento con gli standard interni ABB.

  • Software Excellence: Sicherstellung der Codequalität durch Anwendung moderner Architekturmuster (MVI/MVVM, Clean Architecture, Dependency Injection via Koin/Dagger), Durchführung strenger Code-Reviews, Durchführung statischer Codeanalysen und Nutzung statischer Analysetools (z. B. Detekt, SonarQube).
  • Security & Compliance: Implementierung von Cybersicherheitsmaßnahmen durch Einhaltung des Security Development Lifecycle (SDL), Gewährleistung einer robusten Datenverschlüsselung im Ruhe- und Transitzustand, sicherer Speicherung (Keychain/EncryptedSharedPreferences) und Erfüllung definierter Sicherheitsanforderungen während der gesamten Entwicklung.
  • Local & Cloud Data Management: Entwerfen und Optimieren von lokalen Persistenzlösungen (z. B. Room, SQLDelight) und Verwaltung der nahtlosen Integration mit Cloud-Backends und RESTful/GraphQL-APIs.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

  • Grad: Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Electronic / Computer Science Engineering, Informatik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.
  • Core Mobile Expertise: Solide Erfahrung mit Kotlin, Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) und Compose Multiplatform (Declarative UI) für iOS/Android-Zielausführung.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Praktische Erfahrung mit GitHub Copilot, Cursor oder gleichwertigen KI-unterstützten Codiertools / LLM-Agenten zur sicheren und sicheren Beschleunigung der Softwarebereitstellung, des prompten Prototypings und der Code-Reviews.
  • Asynchrone & reaktive Programmierung: Starke Kenntnisse von Kotlin Coroutines and Flow für gleichzeitiges Zustands- und Stream-Management.
  • Architecture & Libraries: Tiefes Verständnis moderner Android/KMP-Architekturprinzipien, Lifecycle Management, State Handling und Dependency Injection Frameworks (z.B. Koin).
  • DevOps & Cloud Integration: Vertrautheit mit Cloud-Umgebungen (insbesondere Azure) und Erfahrung beim Einrichten von CI/CD-Pipelines für die mobile Bereitstellung.
  • API & Connectivity: Praxiserfahrung mit RESTful APIs, modernen Netzwerkbibliotheken (z. B. Ktor, Retrofit) und IoT-Gerätekommunikationsprotokollen (z. B. BLE, Wi-Fi Provisioning).
  • Cybersecurity: Starkes Verständnis von Best Practices für mobile Sicherheit, statischen Analysetools und sicherer Datenverarbeitung unter SDL-Protokollen.
  • Methodologie:Praxiserfahrung mit Agile/Scrum-Entwicklungsmethoden.
  • Soft Skills: Innovativer Ansatz zur Problemlösung, starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und kollaborative Denkweise.
  • Sprachen:Fließend in Englisch und Italienisch.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Vertrautheit mit agentischen Workflows für Code-Automatisierung, Spec-to-Code-Generierung und automatisierte PR-Review-Bots.
  • Familiarity with Swift/Swift UI for platform-specific iOS bridge integrations.
  • Erfahrung mit lokalen Datenbank-Frameworks, die für KMP geeignet sind (z. B. Room KMP, SQL Delight).
  • Verwandtschaft mit Containerisierung (Docker) und Monitoring-Tools.

Mehr über uns

ABB Smart Power bietet Energieverteilungslösungen für Rechenzentren, Industrie- und Produktionsanlagen, kritische Infrastrukturen und Geschäftsgebäude. Die technischen Teams der Division arbeiten eng mit Industriepartnern zusammen und liefern fortschrittliche Lösungen, die schnelles Wachstum, Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeitsziele unterstützen. Das Portfolio der Division umfasst industrielle Leistungsschalter, Niederspannungssysteme, Motorstartanwendungen und Sicherheitsgeräte wie Schalter und Relais. Seine Power Protection-Einheit unterstützt die weltweit größten Rechenzentrumsunternehmen mit fortschrittlichen energieeffizienten USV-Lösungen. Der ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager der Division bietet eine skalierbare, benutzerfreundliche Plattform, mit der Unternehmen Energie sparen und CO2-Emissionen reduzieren können.

Diese Möglichkeit steht Kandidaten in mehreren Ländern offen, wobei der endgültige Arbeitsstandort auf der Grundlage des ausgewählten Kandidaten festgelegt wird. Da die Vergütung je nach Standort variieren kann, verpflichten wir uns, während des gesamten Einstellungsprozesses transparent zu sein, und teilen Details der Gehaltsspanne, des variablen Vergütungs- und Leistungspakets mit Kandidaten, die in die erste Interviewphase für einen Standort in der Europäischen Union gelangen, der von der EU-Richtlinie über die Entgelttransparenz abgedeckt wird. Das endgültige Angebot wird auf der Grundlage Ihres Standorts, Ihrer Erfahrung, Ihrer Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen, Ihrer Positionierung auf dem Binnenmarkt und Ihrer Ausrichtung auf die internen Standards von ABB zugeschnitten.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Ready to make a impact?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Joignez-vous à nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Cette position se rapporte à:

Chapitre Lead

Votre rôle et responsabilités
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur logiciel expérimenté ayant une solide expérience en développement mobile multiplateforme moderne, notamment en tirant parti de Kotlin Multiplateforme (KMP) et Compose Multiplateforme, appuyé par l'expérience en DevOps, Azure et cybersécurité.

Le candidat retenu jouera un rôle crucial dans la conception, le développement, le déploiement et le maintien d'applications de pointe au sein de l'unité agile numérique. Ce rôle se concentre sur les produits numériques

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : Hybride (#LI-Hybrid)

Clé • Responsabilités :

  • Architecture et développement : Conception d'applications mobiles multiplateforme utilisant Kotlin Multiplateforme (KMP) et Compose Multiplateforme, optimisant le partage de code sur Android et iOS sans compromettre les performances natives ni la fidélité de l'interface utilisateur/UX.
  • Productivité entraînée par l'IA et génie agentique: Promouvoir l'adoption d'outils de programmation par paires d'AI (p. ex., le copilote GitHub) et de workflows d'agents pour rationaliser la génération de code, les tests automatisés des unités, la refacturation et la documentation technique tout en assurant la validation et la sécurité de l'humain dans la boucle.
  • Intégration du système et de l'appareil: Optimiser les conceptions en identifiant les meilleures solutions techniques, y compris les services, les choix architecturaux et les détails techniques. L'accent est mis sur l'intégration transparente entre les applications logicielles et les appareils/matériels intelligents via les protocoles IoT (p. ex. Bluetooth LE, MQTT).
  • Collaboration agile : Appliquer la méthodologie Scrum (Epics, Caractéristiques, User Stories, Bugs). Participation active aux cérémonies de Scrum et collaboration étroite avec les équipes de développement interfonctionnel, UX/UI et de test au sein de l'unité Agile.
  • CI/CD & Automation: Mettre en oeuvre et entretenir des pipelines modernes d'IC/CD (p. ex., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) adaptés aux cibles multiplateformes pour assurer gestion efficace des versions, tests automatisés de l'interface utilisateur/unité et prestation fiable des logiciels.
  • Excellence en logiciel: Assurer la qualité du code en appliquant des modèles architecturaux modernes (MVI/MVVM, architecture propre, injection de dépendance via Koin/Dagger), en effectuant des examens rigoureux du code, en effectuant des analyses de code statique et en tirant parti des outils d'analyse statique (p. ex., Detekt, SonarQube).
  • Sécurité et conformité : Mettre en oeuvre des mesures de cybersécurité en suivant le cycle de vie du développement de la sécurité (LDD), en assurant un cryptage robuste des données au repos et en transit, en assurant un stockage sécurisé (Préférences de la chaîne-clé/encryptée) et en respectant les exigences de sécurité définies tout au long du développement.
  • Gestion des données locales et en nuage: Conception et optimisation de solutions locales de persistance (p. ex. Room, SQLDelight) et gestion d'une intégration transparente avec les moteurs de cloud et les API RESTful/GraphQL.

• Qualifications pour le rôle :

  • Degree: Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie électronique et informatique, en informatique ou dans un domaine technique connexe.
  • Core Mobile Expertise: Expérience solide avec Kotlin, Kotlin Multiplateforme (KMP) et Compose Multiplateforme (interface d'interface utilisateur) pour l'exécution de cibles iOS/Android.
  • Développement assisté par l'IA: Expérience pratique en utilisant GitHub Copilot, Cursor ou des outils de codage assistés par l'IA équivalents / agents LLM pour accélérer la livraison des logiciels, le prototypage accéléré et l'examen des codes en toute sécurité.
  • Programmation asynchrone et réactive: Bonne connaissance de Kotlin Coroutines et Flow pour la gestion simultanée de l'état et du flux.
  • Architecture et bibliothèques: Connaissance approfondie des principes modernes d'architecture Android/KMP, gestion du cycle de vie, gestion de l'état et cadres d'injection de dépendance (p. ex. Koin).
  • DevOps & Cloud Integration: Connaissance des environnements nuageux (en particulier Azure) et expérience de la mise en place de pipelines CI/CD pour la livraison mobile.
  • API & Connectivité: Expérience pratique avec les API REST, les bibliothèques de réseautage modernes (p. ex., Ktor, Retrofit) et les protocoles de communication des appareils IoT (p. ex., BLE, fourniture Wi-Fi).
  • Cybersecurity: Une bonne compréhension des pratiques exemplaires en matière de sécurité mobile, des outils d'analyse statique et du traitement sécurisé des données en vertu des protocoles SDL.
  • Méthodologie: Expérience pratique des méthodes de développement Agile/Scrum.
  • Soft Skills: Approche novatrice de la résolution de problèmes, des compétences solides en communication et de l'esprit de collaboration.
  • Langues: Fluent en anglais et en italien.

< Familiarité avec les workflows d'agents pour l'automatisation des codes, la génération de spec-to-code et les robots automatisés d'examen des PR.
  • Familiarité avec l'interface utilisateur Swift/Swift pour les intégrations de ponts iOS spécifiques à la plate-forme.
  • Expérience des cadres de base de données locaux convenant à KMP (p. ex., salle KMP, SQL Delight).
  • Familiarité avec la conteneurisation (Docker) et les outils de surveillance.

    • Plus sur nous

    ABB Smart Power fournit des solutions de distribution d'énergie pour les centres de données, les usines industrielles et manufacturières, les infrastructures essentielles et les bâtiments commerciaux. Les équipes techniques de la Division travaillent en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires de l'industrie, fournissant des solutions avancées qui soutiennent la croissance rapide, la transition énergétique et les objectifs de durabilité. Le portefeuille de la Division comprend des disjoncteurs industriels, des systèmes à basse tension, des applications de démarrage de moteurs et des dispositifs de sécurité comme les commutateurs et les relais. Son unité de protection de l'énergie prend en charge les plus grandes entreprises de centres de données du monde avec des solutions UPS à haut rendement énergétique. Le gestionnaire de l'énergie ABB AptitudeTM fournit une plateforme évolutive et facile à utiliser qui aide les organisations à économiser de l'énergie et à réduire les émissions de CO2.

    Cette possibilité est ouverte aux candidats dans plusieurs pays, le lieu de travail final étant déterminé en fonction du candidat sélectionné. Étant donné que la rémunération peut varier selon le lieu d'affectation, nous nous engageons à être transparents tout au long du processus d'embauche et partagerons les détails de l'échelle salariale, de la rémunération variable et des avantages sociaux avec les candidats qui passent à la première étape de l'entrevue pour un lieu de l'Union européenne visé par la Directive sur la transparence de la rémunération de l'UE.

    L'offre finale sera adaptée en fonction de l'emplacement, de l'expérience, des compétences et des qualifications, du positionnement et de l'alignement du marché intérieur sur les normes internes ABB.

    Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.
