    Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.title: Software Senior Engineer - Desktop
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities
We are seeking a Software Engineer with a proven track record in Desktop applications, preferably backed by a background in DevOps and Cyber Security. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining cutting-edge applications within the Digital Agile Unit. This role specifically focuses on Desktop SW (Software) application.

The successful candidate will play a crucial role in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining modern multiplatform desktop applications within the Digital Agile Unit, targeting both Windows PCs and Mac environments. This role focuses on digital products and software tools across desktop platforms, covering IoT connectivity, cloud platform integration, device interaction, data management, and reliable user-facing solutions for enterprise users. In addition, you will apply AI-assisted and agentic programming practices in daily development activities to improve productivity, code quality, testing, and technical documentation.

In this role, it is also essential to follow cybersecurity standards, apply appropriate security measures throughout the development process, and comply with ABB’s secure development lifecycle. These practices help ensure that the software released is highly reliable, robust, and secure.


The work model for the role is: Hybrid (#LI-Hybrid)

Key • Responsibilities:

  • Architecture & Development: Design and develop modern Windows desktop applications using Microsoft technologies such as .NET, C#, WPF, WinUI, Windows App SDK, and C++, delivering robust, maintainable, and user-friendly solutions.
  • Professional knowledge of the Microsoft .NET Framework, with in-depth expertise in C# and C++ programming languages for the design, development, and maintenance of desktop applications.
  • Modern Desktop Engineering: Apply contemporary desktop application patterns, including MVVM, dependency injection, modular architecture, asynchronous programming, and responsive UI design to ensure scalable and high-quality software.
  • System & Device Integration: Optimize software designs by identifying the most suitable services, architectural choices, and technical solutions, with a focus on seamless integration between desktop applications, smart devices, hardware, and IoT communication protocols.
  • AI-Driven Productivity & Agentic Engineering: Use AI-assisted coding tools such as GitHub Copilot and agentic workflows to support code generation, refactoring, automated testing, documentation, and code review, while maintaining human oversight and secure development practices.
  • Agile Collaboration: Apply Scrum methodology, including Epics, Features, User Stories, and Bugs, and actively collaborate with development, UX/UI, test, cybersecurity, and product teams within the Agile unit.
  • CI/CD & Automation: Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to support automated builds, testing, packaging, signing, and deployment of Windows desktop applications.
  • Software Excellence: Ensure software quality through code reviews, static code analysis, unit and integration testing, software metrics, and modern engineering practices aimed at building reliable and maintainable applications.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement cybersecurity measures by following the Security Development Lifecycle, secure coding standards, data protection practices, and defined security requirements throughout the development and delivery process.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Degree: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electronic engineering, Computer Science Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Core Desktop Expertise: Solid experience in Windows desktop application development using .NET, C#, WPF, WinUI, Windows App SDK, and/or C++.
  • Modern Windows Technologies: Strong knowledge of modern Windows application architectures, UI frameworks, application lifecycle management, packaging, deployment, and integration with Windows services and APIs.
  • Architecture & Design Patterns: Good understanding of MVVM, Clean Architecture, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, multithreading, and event-driven design for desktop applications.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent AI-assisted coding tools and LLM-based agents to improve productivity, prototyping, testing, refactoring, and code reviews in a safe and controlled way.
  • DevOps & Cloud Integration: Familiarity with Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, release management, and integration with cloud services or RESTful APIs.
  • Device Connectivity: Experience with communication protocols and device integration, such as Modbus, TCP/IP, RS-485, Bluetooth Low Energy, Ethernet, or similar industrial and IoT connectivity technologies.
  • Cybersecurity: Strong understanding of secure coding practices, static analysis tools, secure data handling, authentication, encryption, and Security Development Lifecycle requirements.
  • Methodology: Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
  • Soft Skills: Innovative approach to problem-solving, strong communication skills, and a collaborative mindset.
  • Languages: Fluent in English and Italian.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Familiarity with agentic workflows for code automation, specification-to-code generation, and automated pull request review.
  • Experience with modern Windows deployment and packaging technologies, such as MSIX, ClickOnce, or enterprise software distribution tools.
  • Knowledge of cross-platform desktop frameworks or interoperability scenarios involving Windows, cloud services, and edge devices.
  • Familiarity with containerization, observability, logging, and monitoring tools for desktop-connected solutions.


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and
manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Esperienza solida nello sviluppo delle applicazioni desktop di Windows utilizzando .NET, C#, WPF, WinUI, Windows App SDK e/o C++±/b> Forte conoscenza delle moderne architetture delle applicazioni Windows, dei framework UI, della gestione del ciclo di vita delle applicazioni, dell'imballaggio, dell'implementazione e dell'integrazione con i servizi e le API di Windows. Familiarità con Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, test automatizzati, gestione del rilascio e integrazione con servizi cloud o API RESTful. Esperienza con i protocolli di comunicazione e l'integrazione dei dispositivi, come Modbus, TCP/IP, RS-485, Bluetooth Low Energy, Ethernet o simili tecnologie di connettività industriale e IoT. Forte comprensione delle pratiche di codifica sicura, degli strumenti di analisi statiche, della gestione sicura dei dati, dell'autenticazione, della crittografia e dei requisiti del ciclo di vita di sviluppo di sicurezza. Esperienza pratica con metodi di sviluppo Agile/Scrum. Un approccio innovativo alla risoluzione dei problemi, alle forti capacità di comunicazione e ad una mentalità collaborativa. Familiarità con flussi di lavoro agentici per l'automazione del codice, la generazione specifica-to-code e la revisione automatica delle richieste pull. Esperienza con le moderne tecnologie di distribuzione e confezionamento di Windows, come MSIX, ClickOnce o strumenti di distribuzione di software enterprise. Familiarità con containerizzazione, osservabilità, registrazione e strumenti di monitoraggio per soluzioni desktop-connesse. Maggiori informazioni su di noi I team tecnici della Divisione lavorano a stretto contatto con i partner del settore, offrendo soluzioni avanzate che supportano obiettivi di crescita rapida, transizione energetica e sostenibilità. Il portafoglio della Divisione comprende interruttori industriali, sistemi a bassa tensione, applicazioni di avviamento motore e dispositivi di sicurezza come interruttori e relè. La sua unità Power Protection supporta le più grandi aziende di data center del mondo con soluzioni UPS ad alta efficienza energetica. ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager offre una piattaforma scalabile e facile da usare che consente alle organizzazioni di risparmiare energia e ridurre le emissioni di CO2. Questa opportunità è aperta ai candidati in più paesi, con la posizione di lavoro finale determinata in base al candidato selezionato. Your role and responsibilities
We are seeking a Software Engineer with a proven track record in Desktop applications, preferably backed by a background in DevOps and Cyber Security. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining cutting-edge applications within the Digital Agile Unit. This role specifically focuses on Desktop SW (Software) application.

The successful candidate will play a crucial role in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining modern multiplatform desktop applications within the Digital Agile Unit, targeting both Windows PCs and Mac environments. This role focuses on digital products and software tools across desktop platforms, covering IoT connectivity, cloud platform integration, device interaction, data management, and reliable user-facing solutions for enterprise users. In addition, you will apply AI-assisted and agentic programming practices in daily development activities to improve productivity, code quality, testing, and technical documentation.

In this role, it is also essential to follow cybersecurity standards, apply appropriate security measures throughout the development process, and comply with ABB’s secure development lifecycle. These practices help ensure that the software released is highly reliable, robust, and secure.


The work model for the role is: Hybrid (#LI-Hybrid)

Key • Responsibilities:

  • Architecture & Development: Design and develop modern Windows desktop applications using Microsoft technologies such as .NET, C#, WPF, WinUI, Windows App SDK, and C++, delivering robust, maintainable, and user-friendly solutions.
  • Professional knowledge of the Microsoft .NET Framework, with in-depth expertise in C# and C++ programming languages for the design, development, and maintenance of desktop applications.
  • Modern Desktop Engineering: Apply contemporary desktop application patterns, including MVVM, dependency injection, modular architecture, asynchronous programming, and responsive UI design to ensure scalable and high-quality software.
  • System & Device Integration: Optimize software designs by identifying the most suitable services, architectural choices, and technical solutions, with a focus on seamless integration between desktop applications, smart devices, hardware, and IoT communication protocols.
  • AI-Driven Productivity & Agentic Engineering: Use AI-assisted coding tools such as GitHub Copilot and agentic workflows to support code generation, refactoring, automated testing, documentation, and code review, while maintaining human oversight and secure development practices.
  • Agile Collaboration: Apply Scrum methodology, including Epics, Features, User Stories, and Bugs, and actively collaborate with development, UX/UI, test, cybersecurity, and product teams within the Agile unit.
  • CI/CD & Automation: Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to support automated builds, testing, packaging, signing, and deployment of Windows desktop applications.
  • Software Excellence: Ensure software quality through code reviews, static code analysis, unit and integration testing, software metrics, and modern engineering practices aimed at building reliable and maintainable applications.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement cybersecurity measures by following the Security Development Lifecycle, secure coding standards, data protection practices, and defined security requirements throughout the development and delivery process.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Degree: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electronic engineering, Computer Science Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Core Desktop Expertise: Solid experience in Windows desktop application development using .NET, C#, WPF, WinUI, Windows App SDK, and/or C++.
  • Modern Windows Technologies: Strong knowledge of modern Windows application architectures, UI frameworks, application lifecycle management, packaging, deployment, and integration with Windows services and APIs.
  • Architecture & Design Patterns: Good understanding of MVVM, Clean Architecture, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, multithreading, and event-driven design for desktop applications.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent AI-assisted coding tools and LLM-based agents to improve productivity, prototyping, testing, refactoring, and code reviews in a safe and controlled way.
  • DevOps & Cloud Integration: Familiarity with Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, release management, and integration with cloud services or RESTful APIs.
  • Device Connectivity: Experience with communication protocols and device integration, such as Modbus, TCP/IP, RS-485, Bluetooth Low Energy, Ethernet, or similar industrial and IoT connectivity technologies.
  • Cybersecurity: Strong understanding of secure coding practices, static analysis tools, secure data handling, authentication, encryption, and Security Development Lifecycle requirements.
  • Methodology: Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
  • Soft Skills: Innovative approach to problem-solving, strong communication skills, and a collaborative mindset.
  • Languages: Fluent in English and Italian.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Familiarity with agentic workflows for code automation, specification-to-code generation, and automated pull request review.
  • Experience with modern Windows deployment and packaging technologies, such as MSIX, ClickOnce, or enterprise software distribution tools.
  • Knowledge of cross-platform desktop frameworks or interoperability scenarios involving Windows, cloud services, and edge devices.
  • Familiarity with containerization, observability, logging, and monitoring tools for desktop-connected solutions.


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and
manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Global R&D Controller

Each day, you will compile and analyze various relevant metrics, identify trends and problems, and communicate information to relevant groups. You will also showcase your expertise by recommending actions to improve financial performance of a specific business.

  • Own and manage the customer-funded projects process.

  • Support MDG-F / MDG-C processes and manage purchase order activities.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance accounting or a related field from an accredited institution.

  • 3+ years of experience in similar roles.

  • Experience in ERP (SAP) module, NORRD, Power BI & Excel

  • Skilled in preparation, presentation, and understanding financial analysis and financial results as well as the implementation of action plans to improve financial analysis indicators.

  • Experienced with forecasts for month-end, quarter-end, and year-end.

  • Fluency in English enabling smooth communication is a must.

  • Demonstrated ownership mindset with the ability to take responsibility for assigned tasks, work independently, and proactively drive deliverables to successful completion.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

This position reports to:

Global R&D Controller

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to provide financial expertise to your assigned organization. Each day, you will compile and analyze various relevant metrics, identify trends and problems, and communicate information to relevant groups. You will also showcase your expertise by recommending actions to improve financial performance of a specific business.

  • Own and manage the customer-funded projects process.

  • Support MDG-F / MDG-C processes and manage purchase order activities.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance accounting or a related field from an accredited institution.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

IPU Leader Buy&Sell

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to supervise shift team’s progress against work plans as defined by Production management to ensure the proper use of machinery, equipment, and assembly lines within a production area. Each day, you will provide regular feedback and make recommendations to management regarding issues within the production line, including production line organization, shifting priorities, and possible critical situations. You will also showcase your expertise by cooperating with the unit supervisor to create an effective work environment and reinforcing production schedules and quality.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite.

This role is contributing to the IPU BUY&SELL in Quartino.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Helping management implement staff movements in case of vacations, illnesses, machine outages, or shifting priorities.

  • Reinforcing focus on volume, efficiency, and on-time delivery.

  • Assisting management and shift team in allocating, coordinating, and overseeing shift orders and work plan execution within production lines during the shift.

  • Serving as a leader during shifts to oversee cooperation and the resolution of technical/quality problems and logistic issues.

You will join a dynamic and collaborative team, where you will be able to thrive.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Technical Diploma in Electronics, Electrical Technician, or a related field.

  • Knowledge of three-phase electrical systems and ability to read and interpret electrical and electronic schematics.

  • Proficiency in using electrical test equipment, including multimeters, wattmeters, and oscilloscopes.

  • Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented and cross-functional environment. Previous experience in troubleshooting and fault diagnosis of electrical/electronic systems.

  • Knowledge of SAP as well as previous experience working with Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems.

  • Fluency in Italian

More about us:

ABB Electrification is a global technology leader making efficient use of electricity from substation to socket possible. With more than 50,000 employees across 100 countries, we bring innovation to electrical distribution, energy management solutions and services. We seek out and partner with the brightest minds in the industry - from universities to startups to technology-focused businesses - finding innovative ways to decarbonize energy production and to enhance circularity.
ABB Electrification offers leading technologies, from medium- and low-voltage switchgear to electrical components and digital devices. Our solutions incorporate products, services, software and expertise for smart buildings, industry, data centers, utilities, transportation and more.
Our products are enhanced by ABB's digital solutions including augmented reality and preventative maintenance. These digital tools provide data-driven insights for greater energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for residential, commercial and industrial buildings. In collaboration with our customers and partners, we are solving the world’s greatest challenges to drive efficiency, reliability and sustainability.

This recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Team Lead, ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__


Your role and responsibilities

The mission of this team is to bring modern and disruptive power electronic solutions from research into product development. We improve our products by holistic optimization, pushing forward novel converter topologies as well as optimizing key components. By joining us, you will participate in idea generation at the frontier of academic research and industrial applications, as well as in the development of advanced technologies for ABB’s products.

Do you want to contribute to a greener future by utilizing advanced and highly efficient power-electronic solutions for various applications? Get in touch with us! A talented, multinational team is looking forward to welcoming you as their latest team member!

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Simulate, compare, and optimize power electronic topologies and converter systems for a wide range of applications, including system-level studies and performance evaluations

  • Collaborate closely with colleagues within the team and across disciplines, sharing expertise, mentoring team members, and contributing to a culture of innovation and continuous learning

  • Design, implement, commission, and experimentally validate advanced power converter systems, from proof-of-concept models to full-scale demonstrators

  • Develop and advance innovative power electronic topologies, control strategies, and converter solutions for emerging applications

• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in Engineering, or a Master's degree with at least 3 years of relevant experience in power electronic converter design, optimization, and testing, or in system-level studies, including architecture trade-offs for large power converters, scaling across varying voltage and power levels, and/or grid interactions under dynamic operating conditions

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken

    Expertise in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

  • Hands-on experience in commissioning and testing full-scale converter systems, including back-to-back power flow setups

  • Experience in the design, implementation, and validation of high-power medium-voltage converters and/or grid-connected three-phase inverters

  • Strong knowledge of applied control theory and power converter control, including experience with embedded hardware development and programming of FPGAs (VHDL) and/or microcontrollers for power electronic applications

  • Experience in optimization-driven power stage design, supported by simulation and experimental validation

More about us

At the ABB research center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

- Simulation, Vergleich und Optimierung von Leistungselektronik-Topologien und Konvertersystemen für eine Vielzahl von Anwendungen, einschließlich Systemstudien und Leistungsbewertungen - enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen innerhalb des Teams und in allen Disziplinen, Austausch von Fachwissen, Mentoring-Teammitglieder und Beitrag zu einer Kultur der Innovation und des kontinuierlichen Lernens - Design, Implementierung, Kommission und experimentell validieren fortgeschrittene Leistungswandlersysteme, von Proof-of-Concept-Modellen bis hin zu umfassenden Demonstratoren - Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung innovativer Leistungselektronik-Topologien, Steuerungsstrategien,

und Konverterlösungen für neue Anwendungen

Anforderungen

Qualifikationen für die Rolle

- Doktortitel in Ingenieurwissenschaften oder Master-Abschluss mit mindestens 3 Jahren einschlägiger Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Optimierung und Erprobung von Stromwandlern oder in Systemstudien, einschließlich Architektur-Austausch für große Stromwandler, Skalierung über unterschiedliche Spannungs- und Leistungsstufen und/oder Netzinteraktionen unter dynamischen Betriebsbedingungen - Fluency in English, sowohl schriftlich als auch gesprochen

Ein Fachwissen in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche ist sehr wünschenswert:

- Erfahrung in der Inbetriebnahme und Erprobung von Vollformatwandlern, einschließlich Back-to-back-Stromfluss-Setups - Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Implementierung und Validierung von Hochleistungs-Mittelspannungswandlern und/oder netzgebundenen Dreiphasen-Wechselrichtern - Starkes Wissen über angewandte Steuerungstheorie und Power-Konverter-Steuerung, einschließlich Erfahrung mit Embedded Hardware Entwicklung und Programmierung von FPGAs (VHDL) und/oder Microcontrollern für stromelektronische Anwendungen - Erfahrung in der optimierungsgesteuerten Leistungsstufen-Design, unterstützt durch Simulation und experimentelle Validierung

Am ABB-Forschungszentrum Baden-Dättwil in Zürich arbeiten wir an spannenden Technologien, die die Zukunft unserer Produkte prägen. Unsere internationalen Forschungsteams konzentrieren sich auf die Bereiche Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems und Switching.

Business Manager - Commercial&Operations

__

Working in the Energy Industries division, based in eastern Europe, optionally worldwide, you will be cooperating with international teams to maintain the highest levels of customer satisfaction in our worldwide applied solutions for electrical power generation. Reporting to the Head of Product Support, you will perform various product and life cycle activities to assist in the development, launch, maintenance, and profitability of UNITROL, MEGATROL and SYNCHROTACT products.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Own product lifecycle management and continuous improvement by leading feasibility studies and managing global product changes (HW/SW/BOM, tools, documentation, etc.).   • Strengthen knowledge sharing and team capabilities by capturing learnings from support cases and translating them into structured knowledge documentation. You coach support line specialists and contribute to building strong global lifecycle support expertise

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor or master’s in electrical engineering
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in field service or engineering with Power Generation System know how, Embedded Software and Control Hardware plus Power Electronics (Experience with excitation systems is required)

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__


Your role and responsibilities

As a Commissioning Engineer, you will oversee commissioning in projects with low to medium complexity, and guide Associate Commissioning Engineers and coordinating work. You will ensure that commissioning activities are completed efficiently and cost-effectively, in accordance with specifications, standards, and safety requirements.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Energy Industries division in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Commissioning and servicing of Automatic Voltage Regulators and Static Excitation Systems in power plants of all types and sizes, including voltage regulators in power plant installations with capacities up to 1000 MW. Conduct remote services and support to enhance the solutions and additionally perform network stability studies with a focus on power plant stabilities and grid code compliance.

  • Assist in continuous improvement of project design, participate in project review meetings, and provide input on service activities. Help create proposals for engineering projects or programs and assist Contract Managers in issuing claims.

  • Create work plans and cost estimates for various tasks, conduct risk and opportunity assessments during commissioning, and report potential risks and resolutions. Identify and recommend solutions to meet business and customer needs and provide relevant information accordingly.

  • Provide information to contractors and colleagues and give feedback to the organization to apply lessons learned. Apply and improve processes and tools through automation and digitalization to ensure effective project delivery.

• Qualifications for the role

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in either commissioning for the power generation industry or as power system engineer responsible for power system studies.

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach and written and spoken communication skills in English (German advance).

  • Excitement and interest for digitalization of remote service concepts.

  • In-depth knowledge of power systems simulation tools (PowerFactory and PSS\E), synchronous machines and excitation systems as well as profound understanding of control theory, data analysis and information technology.

  • Eagerness to engage directly with clients and teams worldwide—travel commitment up to 60%.

Service Manager

Your role and responsibilities

As a Commissioning Engineer, you will oversee commissioning in projects with low to medium complexity, and guide Associate Commissioning Engineers and coordinating work. Conduct remote services and support to enhance the solutions and additionally perform network stability studies with a focus on power plant stabilities and grid code compliance.

Global Head of Mobile e-Power

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this position you will be responsible for driving the strategy, development, commercialization, and lifecycle management of ABB's Mobile e-Power Systems portfolio.

You will manage ABB’s global Mobile e-Power Systems portfolio, including power converters, electric traction motors, battery energy storage, power distribution, and control systems for applications across mining, construction, off-highway equipment, public transportation, marine, and other industrial mobility segments. Working closely with customers, OEMs, sales, engineering, R&D, and operations teams, you will drive portfolio strategy, support key electrification projects, and translate market needs into innovative solutions that accelerate business growth and strengthen ABB’s leadership in sustainable mobility.

Work model: hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Leading the market intelligence analysis and identifying potential gaps in the portfolio, with respect to the competition and new market opportunities.

  • Owning technical and market specification for the offer and determining an offering business plan that supports sustainable growth while leading customer need and value analysis, planning the roadmap to create maximum value, and following-up on portfolio performance.

  • Leading the offer lifecycle management process, analyzing current offers, defining, and tracking performance metrics, and making decisions on offer obsolescence and end-of life to ensure that current and future market requirements are met to maximize their profitability.

  • Setting targets, monitoring offering costs and giving inputs to operations functions (e.g., Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Production) to maximize competitiveness and profitability.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in product management, systems engineering, business development, application engineering, or related roles.

  • Experience with electrified powertrain systems, power electronics, electric drives, battery systems, charging systems, energy storage systems, or related electrification technologies.

  • Solid understanding of product lifecycle management, portfolio strategy, and business planning.

  • Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global, and multicultural environments.

  • Strong analytical, strategic, commercial, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English.

  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (approximately 10–20%) to support business growth and portfolio objectives.


More about us

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. Cette position se rapporte à:

Global Head of Mobile e-Power

Votre rôle et responsabilités

Dans ce poste, vous serez responsable du pilotage de la stratégie, du développement, de la commercialisation et de la gestion du cycle de vie du portefeuille de systèmes de puissance électronique mobiles d'ABB.

Vous gérerez le portefeuille mondial de systèmes d'alimentation en ligne mobiles d'ABB, y compris les convertisseurs d'énergie, les moteurs de traction électrique, le stockage de l'énergie des batteries, la distribution d'énergie et les systèmes de contrôle pour les applications dans les secteurs minier, de la construction, des équipements hors route, des transports en commun, de la navigation et d'autres secteurs de la mobilité industrielle. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les clients, les OEM, les équipes de vente, d'ingénierie, de R-D et d'exploitation, vous dirigerez la stratégie de portefeuille, appuierez des projets clés d'électrification et traduireez les besoins du marché en solutions novatrices qui accélèrent la croissance des entreprises et renforcent le leadership d'ABB dans le domaine de la mobilité durable.

Modèle de travail: hybride

Vous serez principalement responsable :

  • Diriger l'analyse des renseignements sur les marchés et cerner les lacunes potentielles dans le portefeuille, en ce qui concerne la concurrence et les nouvelles possibilités de marché.

  • Posséder des spécifications techniques et de marché pour l'offre et déterminer un plan d'affaires d'offre qui soutient la croissance durable tout en dirigeant les besoins des clients et l'analyse de la valeur, en planifiant la feuille de route pour créer une valeur maximale et en suivant la performance du portefeuille.

  • Diriger le processus de gestion du cycle de vie de l'offre, analyser les offres actuelles, définir et suivre les mesures de rendement, et prendre des décisions sur l'obsolescence et la fin de vie de l'offre pour s'assurer que les exigences actuelles et futures du marché sont satisfaites pour maximiser leur rentabilité.

jobs.description:

This position reports to:

Local Division Manager

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will spend approximately 80% of your time at customer sites. You will acquire new business partners and continuously develop existing customer relationships. By leveraging your technical expertise and sales experience, you will understand customer needs and clearly articulate the value of our electric motors and variable frequency drives (low voltage and medium voltage).

As a key driver of growth in our drives business, you will succeed through knowledgeable consulting and clear value‑based selling—ranging from energy efficiency to CO₂ reduction. Your objective is to deliver solutions that are not only technically strong but also contribute to a more sustainable and environmentally responsible industry.

This role follows a hybrid work model. #LI‑Hybrid

Your • Qualifications

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

  • Willingness to travel extensively (approximately 80% field‑based).

  • Strong interest in energy efficiency and sustainable solutions.

  • Fluent in German and French.

What We Offer

  • An exciting sales role with significant autonomy and impact.

  • Access to innovative products and solutions within the Motion business area.

  • Ongoing learning opportunities and attractive career development prospects.

  • Modern work tools and flexible work arrangements.

More about us

ABB Motors and Drives offers a comprehensive portfolio of motors, generators, and drive products for a wide range of industries and applications. Approfittando della vostra esperienza tecnica e di vendita, comprenderete le esigenze dei clienti e articolarete chiaramente il valore dei nostri motori elettrici e delle unità a frequenza variabile (bassa tensione e media tensione).

Come motore chiave della crescita del nostro business, riuscirete attraverso una consulenza competente e una vendita basata sul valore chiaro. che spazia dall'efficienza energetica alla riduzione delle emissioni di CO2. Il vostro obiettivo è quello di fornire soluzioni non solo tecnicamente forti ma anche contribuire a un'industria più sostenibile e responsabile per l'ambiente.

Questo ruolo segue un modello ibrido di lavoro. #LI-Hybrid

Chiave
• Responsabilità

- Gestione Acquisizione e Account del Cliente: Trascorrete circa l'80% del vostro tempo in loco con i clienti, individuando nuove opportunità di business e ampliando le relazioni esistenti con i clienti.

- Consulenza tecnica: consigliate i clienti sui motori elettrici e sulle unità a frequenza variabile (LV & MV) e presentate soluzioni su misura per le loro esigenze tecniche e aziendali.

- Comunicazione sul valore: comunicare chiaramente i vantaggi dei nostri prodotti, tra cui il miglioramento dell'efficienza energetica e la riduzione delle emissioni di CO2.

- Gestione delle relazioni: Crea fiducia, identifica i principali stakeholder e posiziona strategicamente le nostre soluzioni.

- Consapevolezza del mercato e dell'industria: monitorare le tendenze nel settore dei motori e del moto e contribuire a idee innovative.

Le tue qualifiche

- Laurea o formazione tecnica in Ingegneria Elettrica, Ingegneria Meccanica, o un campo comparabile.

- Diversi anni di esperienza nelle vendite, con una forte conoscenza dei motori elettrici e dei motori a frequenza variabile (LV & MV).

- Ottima capacità di comunicazione e negoziazione.

- Volontà di viaggiare ampiamente (circa 80% sul campo).

- Forte interesse per l'efficienza energetica e soluzioni sostenibili.

- Fluente in tedesco e francese.

Cosa offriamo

- Un ruolo di vendita emozionante con notevole autonomia e impatto.

- Accesso a prodotti e soluzioni innovative nell'area Motion.

- opportunità di apprendimento in corso e prospettive di sviluppo professionale interessanti.

- Strumenti di lavoro moderni e disposizioni di lavoro flessibili.

Più su di noi

ABB Motors and Drives offre un portafoglio completo di motori, generatori e prodotti per la guida in un'ampia gamma di settori e applicazioni. La nostra missione è quella di essere un esperto affidabile in sistemi industriali automatizzati, con una forte attenzione all'affidabilità, partnership a lungo termine e una profonda comprensione delle esigenze dei nostri clienti.

Il processo di reclutamento è guidato da Ece Özen, Partner di Total, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente richiede ogni tipo di mente: il curioso, il coraggioso e il creativo. Ecco perché accogliamo persone provenienti da ogni provenienza ed esperienza.

Pronto a fare un impatto?

Applica oggi o visita https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.

• Verantwortung

In dieser Funktion verbringen Sie rund 80% Ihrer Zeit an Kundenstandorten. Sie erwerben neue Geschäftspartner und entwickeln bestehende Kundenbeziehungen kontinuierlich. Durch die Nutzung Ihrer technischen Expertise und Vertriebserfahrung verstehen Sie die Kundenbedürfnisse und artikulieren den Wert unserer Elektromotoren und variablen Frequenzantriebe (Niederspannung und Mittelspannung).

Als wichtiger Wachstumstreiber in unserem Kerngeschäft gelingt Ihnen durch fundierte Beratung und einen klaren wertbasierten Vertrieb – von der Energieeffizienz bis zur CO2-Reduktion. Schlüssel
• Zuständigkeiten

- Customer Acquisition & Account Management: Verbringen Sie etwa 80% Ihrer Zeit vor Ort mit Kunden, identifizieren Sie neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und erweitern Sie bestehende Kundenbeziehungen.

- Technische Beratung: Beratung der Kunden bei Elektromotoren und variablen Frequenzantrieben (LV & MV) und Präsentation von Lösungen, die auf ihre technischen und geschäftlichen Anforderungen zugeschnitten sind.

- Value Communication: Die Vorteile unserer Produkte, einschließlich verbesserter Energieeffizienz und reduzierter CO2-Emissionen, werden klar kommuniziert.

- Relationship Management: Vertrauen aufbauen, wichtige Stakeholder identifizieren und unsere Lösungen strategisch positionieren.

- Markt & Industrie Bewusstsein: Überwachen Sie Trends in der Antriebs- und Bewegungsindustrie und bringen Sie innovative Ideen ein.

• Qualifikationen

- Bachelor, s Studium oder technische Ausbildung in Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Vertrieb, mit starken Kenntnissen von Elektromotoren und variablen Frequenzantrieben (LV & MV).

- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und Verhandlungsfähigkeit.

- Bereitschaft, ausgiebig zu reisen (etwa 80% auf Feldbasis).

- Starkes Interesse an Energieeffizienz und nachhaltigen Lösungen.

- Fließend in Deutsch und Französisch.

Was wir anbieten

- Eine spannende Verkaufsrolle mit erheblicher Autonomie und Wirkung.

- Zugang zu innovativen Produkten und Lösungen im Geschäftsbereich Motion.

- Laufende Lernmöglichkeiten und attraktive Karriereaussichten.

- Moderne Arbeitswerkzeuge und flexible Arbeitsgestaltung.

Mehr über uns

ABB Motors and Drives bietet ein umfassendes Portfolio an Motoren, Generatoren und Antriebsprodukten für eine Vielzahl von Branchen und Anwendungen. Unser Ziel ist es, ein vertrauenswürdiger Experte für automatisierte Industriesysteme zu sein, mit einem starken Fokus auf Zuverlässigkeit, langfristige Partnerschaften und einem tiefen Verständnis unserer Kunden, Bedürfnisse.

Die Rekrutierung wird von Ece Özen, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd. geleitet.

Eine sauberere, intelligentere Zukunft zu schaffen, erfordert alle Arten von Gedanken: Neugierige, Mutige und Kreative. Deshalb heißen wir Menschen aus allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen willkommen.

- Volonté de voyager largement (environ 80 % sur le terrain).

- Un vif intérêt pour l'efficacité énergétique et les solutions durables.

- Un rôle de vente passionnant avec une autonomie et un impact significatifs.

- Accès à des produits et solutions innovants dans le domaine des affaires Motion.

- Possibilités d'apprentissage continues et perspectives de carrière attrayantes.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Field Service Engineer


Your role and responsibilities

As a Service Engineer, you will execute service work on rolling stock and energy storing systems with low to medium complexity according to work instructions and in accordance with ABB standard processes, quality standards and safety guidelines. You will be in close cooperation with customers and other ABB teams, acting as the technical point while delivering quality and satisfying customer service.

Reporting to the Head of Field Service, you will be responsible for providing routine maintenance and on-site or remote technical support. The position involves approximately 50 days of domestic and 30 days of international travel, as you will be providing hands-on assistance at customer sites.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Performing service tasks like installation and commissioning of equipment, identifying technical problems, making analysis through remote or on-site activity in different service categories (installation and commissioning, routine maintenance, extensions, replacements etc.)
  • Consulting with and advising customers on the best service solutions in accordance with standard processes, procedures, and safety guidelines. Furthermore creating and maintaining strong relationships with customers, appreciating their needs, and providing specialist assistance and solutions
  • Coordinating and executing specialist projects through planning, meeting milestones and regular reviews
  • Troubleshooting simple equipment failure and making recommendations to avoid repeating the problem in the future. Identifying opportunities to develop new service applications, equipment and methods

• Qualifications for the role

  • Four years of experience in electrical work, testing, maintenance, or service, working as test- or commissioning engineer with power electronics or on electrical vehicles
  • Knowledge and hands-on experience in servicing, maintaining, commissioning and repairing of power electronic products
  • Ability to travel worldwide
  • Proven leadership skills, with a collaborative, solution-focused approach and strong written and spoken communication skills
  • A technician or engineer bachelor’s degree in electrotechnics
  • Required language skills are fluent German, French, and English

More about us

ABB Traction Division is a recognized leader in onboard propulsion technologies that drive innovation in rail, bus, and industrial vehicle electrification. A comprehensive range of high-performance and full lifecycle managed propulsion, auxiliary and energy storage solutions help improve energy efficiency and contribute to making transportation more sustainable. We all together make the difference for our customers every day. We look forward to receiving your application.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com. ABB Data Privacy Statement: https://new.abb.com/privacy-notice/candidate

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità

A s a Service Engineer, eseguirete il servizio di assistenza su materiale rotabile e sistemi di stoccaggio dell'energia con una bassa o media complessità secondo le istruzioni di lavoro e in conformità con i processi standard ABB, gli standard di qualità e le linee guida di sicurezza. Sarete in stretta collaborazione con i clienti e altri team ABB, fungendo da punto tecnico nel fornire qualità e servizio clienti soddisfacente.

Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è: #LI-Hybrid

Le principali responsabilità comprendono:

- Performare compiti di servizio come l'installazione e la messa in servizio di apparecchiature, individuare problemi tecnici, effettuare analisi attraverso attività remote o in loco in diverse categorie di servizi (installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione di routine, estensioni, sostituzioni ecc.)

- Consulenza e consulenza dei clienti sulle migliori soluzioni di servizio in conformità con i processi, le procedure e le linee guida di sicurezza standard. Inoltre c ritaking e mantenere rapporti forti con i clienti, apprezzando le loro esigenze, e fornendo assistenza e soluzioni specialistiche

- Coordinare ed eseguire progetti specialistici attraverso la pianificazione, il raggiungimento di tappe e revisioni periodiche

- Risoluzione dei problemi relativi alla semplice mancanza di attrezzature e raccomandazioni per evitare di ripetere il problema in futuro.

- Quattro anni di esperienza nel lavoro elettrico, prove, manutenzione o servizio, lavorando come ingegnere di prova o di messa in servizio con elettronica di potenza o su veicoli elettrici

- K nowledge ed esperienza pratica nella manutenzione, manutenzione, messa in servizio e riparazione di prodotti elettronici di alimentazione

- Capacità di viaggiare in tutto il mondo

- Competenze di leadership di Proven, con un approccio collaborativo e risolutivo e forte capacità comunicative scritte e parlate

- Laurea in elettrotecnica in ingegneria o ingegneria

- Le competenze linguistiche richieste sono fluenti in tedesco, francese e inglese

Più su di noi

ABB Traction Division è un leader riconosciuto nelle tecnologie di propulsione a bordo che guidano l'innovazione nell'elettrificazione di veicoli ferroviari, autobus e industriali. Una gamma completa di propulsione ad alte prestazioni e a ciclo di vita gestito, soluzioni ausiliarie e di stoccaggio dell'energia contribuiscono a migliorare l'efficienza energetica e contribuiscono a rendere i trasporti più sostenibili. Tutti insieme facciamo la differenza per i nostri clienti ogni giorno.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Power Electronic Systems

__

Your role and responsibilities

Our team's mission is to drive innovations at the intersection of power electronic converters and microgrid integration, translating cutting-edge research into next-generation ABB products. We focus on converter operation, intelligent protection coordination, load sharing, and stabilizing control strategies. By joining us, you will shape the future of energy systems - generating pioneering ideas at the frontier of academic research and industrial innovation, while developing transformative technologies that power ABB's product portfolio.

Are you passionate about enabling a sustainable future through power converter-based distribution systems? We want to hear from you! A dynamic, international team is excited to welcome you as our newest member. Together, we will push boundaries and make a lasting impact on the energy transition.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Pioneer innovative concepts in power electronic converter-based, low voltage and medium voltage, AC and DC distribution systems

  • Conduct detailed simulations, algorithm development, and laboratory experiments and publish research findings and patent innovative solutions

  • Collaborate with global, multidisciplinary teams of scientists at ABB Research

  • Work closely with ABB business units to transition research into real-world applications, including data centers, integration of renewables, industrial electrification, e-mining, and marine systems

• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in Electrical Engineering with specialization in power electronics, power systems, or control

  • Proven research excellence demonstrated through high-impact publications and patents

  • Deep technical expertise in:
    - Power electronic converter topologies, modulation and control concepts
    - Interactions between converters, passive components, and protection devices
    - Microgrid modeling, optimization and stability analysis

  • Hands-on laboratory skills with a proactive, self-driven approach to designing, building, and testing converter systems and protection schemes. Versatile skill set with the ability to bridge theory and practice across multiple technical domains

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced industrial research environment and deliver results

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal


More about us

At the ABB Research Center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.


This recruitment process is led by Pedro Labian, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd.

IS Service Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that users have the precise access rights required for their tasks - adhering to the principle of least privilege.

You will support the business units as main contact regarding the role concept and authorizations, as well as in all SAP User Access Management topics.

You will also showcase your skills by continuously improving our GRC application and access control processes.

This role serves as a vital bridge between IT infrastructure and business departments to protect sensitive data while maintaining operational efficiency

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Maintaining and developing the SAP role and authorization concepts in collaboration with functional departments.

  • Conducting user access reviews and regular access controls for internal and external audits.

  • Analyzing and evaluating critical authorizations and Segregation of Duties (SoD) conflicts.

  • Manage and further develop the SAP GRC system (Access Control, Risk Analysis & Remediation, Firefighter).

Our team dynamics

You will join a multicultural SAP team where you can thrive. Locally, the team consists of six members including the Hiring Manager, and in total you will collaborate with an extended team of 15–20 people, as well as external service providers.   • Several years of practical experience in SAP Roles & Authorization Management, ideally including S/4HANA and Fiori.

  • Experience as an SAP security consultant or in a similar SAP security/authorization role.

  • Solid understanding of audit requirements, IT security, and compliance processes.

  • Practical skills in resolving authorization issues (e.g., SU53, system traces) and supporting SAP upgrades and projects.

  • Good knowledge of SAP GRC Access Control (e.g., ARA, EAM/Firefighter, ARM, BRM) and maintaining SoD rules and risk definitions.

  • Solid communication, teamwork, and problem‑solving skills, combined with a structured working style.

  • Completed vocational training or a university degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a comparable field.

  • Professional‑level German and English skills (C1–C2).

  • Attractive compensation package, including bonus, 13th-month salary, and employee stock participation opportunities (ESAP)

  • Career development through targeted training and growth opportunities

  • Contribution toward your gym membership and access to medical services (IFA)

  • REKA checks and Swibeco discounts

  • Paid company shutdown between Christmas and New Year, provided on top of regular vacation days

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

IS Service Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that users have the precise access rights required for their tasks - adhering to the principle of least privilege.

You will support the business units as main contact regarding the role concept and authorizations, as well as in all SAP User Access Management topics.

You will also showcase your skills by continuously improving our GRC application and access control processes.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role serves as a vital bridge between IT infrastructure and business departments to protect sensitive data while maintaining operational efficiency

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Maintaining and developing the SAP role and authorization concepts in collaboration with functional departments.

  • Conducting user access reviews and regular access controls for internal and external audits.

  • Analyzing and evaluating critical authorizations and Segregation of Duties (SoD) conflicts.

  • Manage and further develop the SAP GRC system (Access Control, Risk Analysis & Remediation, Firefighter).

Our team dynamics

You will join a multicultural SAP team where you can thrive. Locally, the team consists of six members including the Hiring Manager, and in total you will collaborate with an extended team of 15–20 people, as well as external service providers. We value collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Several years of practical experience in SAP Roles & Authorization Management, ideally including S/4HANA and Fiori.

  • Experience as an SAP security consultant or in a similar SAP security/authorization role.

  • Solid understanding of audit requirements, IT security, and compliance processes.

  • Practical skills in resolving authorization issues (e.g., SU53, system traces) and supporting SAP upgrades and projects.

  • Good knowledge of SAP GRC Access Control (e.g., ARA, EAM/Firefighter, ARM, BRM) and maintaining SoD rules and risk definitions.

  • Solid communication, teamwork, and problem‑solving skills, combined with a structured working style.

  • Completed vocational training or a university degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a comparable field.

  • Professional‑level German and English skills (C1–C2).

Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Attractive compensation package, including bonus, 13th-month salary, and employee stock participation opportunities (ESAP)

  • Career development through targeted training and growth opportunities

  • Contribution toward your gym membership and access to medical services (IFA)

  • REKA checks and Swibeco discounts

  • Paid company shutdown between Christmas and New Year, provided on top of regular vacation days

More about us

ABB Motion provides innovative technology, products, solutions and related services to

industrial customers to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and maintain precise control over processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators and drives for a wide range of applications in all industrial sectors.

The recruitment process is led by Talent Partner, Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
descriptionByLocale.de:
At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, das zu steuern, was die Welt beherrscht.

Diese Position berichtet an:

IS Service Manager

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

In dieser Rolle sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, dass die Benutzer die genauen Zugriffsrechte haben, die für ihre Aufgaben erforderlich sind - wobei Sie sich an das Prinzip der geringsten Privilegien halten.

Sie unterstützen die Business Units als Hauptansprechpartner beim Rollenkonzept und den Berechtigungen sowie bei allen SAP User Access Management Themen.

Sie werden auch Ihre Fähigkeiten präsentieren, indem Sie unsere GRC-Anwendungs- und Zugriffskontrollprozesse kontinuierlich verbessern.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: hybrid

Diese Rolle stellt eine wichtige Brücke zwischen IT-Infrastruktur und Geschäftsabteilungen dar, um sensible Daten zu schützen und gleichzeitig die betriebliche Effizienz zu gewährleisten

  • Die Aufrechterhaltung und Entwicklung der SAP-Rollen- und Autorisierungskonzepte in Zusammenarbeit mit funktionalen Abteilungen.

  • Durchführung von Benutzerzugriffsüberprüfungen und regelmäßigen Zugriffskontrollen für interne und externe Audits.

  • Analyse und Bewertung kritischer Autorisierungen und Konflikte bei der Aufgabentrennung (SoD)

  • Verwaltung und Weiterentwicklung des SAP GRC-Systems (Access Control, Risk Analysis & Remediation, Firefighter).

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in SAP Roles & Authorization Management, idealerweise einschließlich S/4HANA und Fiori.

  • Erfahren Sie als SAP-Sicherheitsberater oder in einer ähnlichen SAP-Sicherheits-/Autorisierungsrolle.

  • Solid Verständnis für Audit-Anforderungen, IT-Sicherheit und Compliance-Prozesse.

  • Praktische Fähigkeiten bei der Lösung von Berechtigungsproblemen (z. B. SU53, System-Traces) und Unterstützung von SAP-Upgrades und -Projekten.

  • Solid Regeln und Risikodefinitionen.

  • Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder ein Universitätsabschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

  • Karriereentwicklung durch gezielte Schulungs- und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten

  • Beitrag zu Ihrer Fitness-Studio-Mitgliedschaft und Zugang zu medizinischen Dienstleistungen (IFA)

  • REKA-Schecks und Swibeco-Rabatte

  • Bezahlte Betriebsschließung zwischen Weihnachten und Neujahr

    • Der Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Talent Partner Ece Özen geleitet.

    Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

    Ready to make a impact?

    Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.

À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Joignez-vous à nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui fonctionne dans le monde.

Ce poste relève de:

IS Service Manager

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous devrez vous assurer que les utilisateurs ont les droits d'accès précis requis pour leurs tâches - en respectant le principe du moins de privilège.

Vous soutiendrez les unités opérationnelles comme contact principal concernant le concept de rôle et les autorisations, ainsi que dans tous les sujets de gestion de l'accès des utilisateurs SAP.

Vous présenterez également vos compétences en améliorant continuellement nos processus d'application et de contrôle d'accès au GRC.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : hybride

Ce rôle sert de pont vital entre l'infrastructure de TI et les ministères afin de protéger les données sensibles tout en maintenant l'efficacité opérationnelle

Vous serez principalement responsable :

  • Maintenir et élaborer les concepts de rôle et d'autorisation du SAP en collaboration avec les ministères fonctionnels.

  • Conduire des examens de l'accès des utilisateurs et des contrôles d'accès réguliers pour les vérifications internes et externes.

  • Analyse et évaluation des conflits d'autorisations critiques et de séparation des fonctions (SoD).

  • Gérer et développer davantage le système SAP GRC (contrôle de l'accès, analyse des risques et réparation, pompiers).

    Notre dynamique d'équipes

    < Vous rejoindrez une équipe SAP multiculturelle où vous pourrez prospérer. Sur le plan local, l'équipe est composée de six membres, dont le gestionnaire de l'embauche, et vous collaborerez au total avec une équipe élargie de 15 à 20 personnes, ainsi qu'avec des fournisseurs de services externes. Nous valorisons la collaboration, la qualité et l'amélioration continue.

    •

    <>

    Trousse de rémunération attrayante, y compris la prime, le salaire de 13e mois et les possibilités de participation des employés au stock (PAES)

  • Développement des carrières grâce à des possibilités de formation et de croissance ciblées

  • Contribution à l'adhésion à votre salle de gymnastique et à l'accès aux services médicaux (IFA)

  • Reka checks and Swibeco reductions

  • Maîtrise de l'entreprise entre Noël et le Nouvel An, fournie en plus des jours de vacances ordinaires

En savoir plus sur nous

Motion fournit des technologies, des produits, des solutions et des services novateurs aux clients industriels afin d'accroître l'efficacité énergétique, d'améliorer la sécurité et la fiabilité et de maintenir un contrôle précis sur les processus. Le portefeuille comprend des moteurs, des générateurs et des moteurs pour une vaste gamme d'applications dans tous les secteurs industriels.

Le processus de recrutement est dirigé par Talent Partner, Ece Özen.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.
